title.rendered: Tim Cook Says Apple Is Now ‘Open to’ Big AI Acquisitions

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple shifts to bigger AI deals by considering large-scale acquisitions like Perplexity AI, marking a move away from its usual small startup buys.
  • AI race heats up across tech giants as Apple scrambles to catch up with OpenAI, Google, and Meta, adding AI features more cautiously and slowly.
  • Tim Cook signals a bold M&A pivot by confirming Apple’s readiness to spend more on deals that speed up innovation in AI and beyond.
  • Tariff threats may raise iPhone prices due to rising manufacturing costs from trade tensions, pushing Apple to rethink how it grows revenue.
  • Future Apple deals could be massive but carry risk—no major buyout has been finalized yet, and AI investments may not pay off quickly.

Apple may be rethinking one of its oldest playbooks. Historically known for acquiring small startups under the radar, the company now appears open to a different approach, especially when it comes to artificial intelligence.

In comments made during Apple’s Q3 2025 earnings call, CEO Tim Cook told CNBC that Apple is no longer ruling out large-scale acquisitions. If a deal can meaningfully accelerate Apple’s AI ambitions, he said, the company is willing to go bigger than it ever has before.

AI Pressure Is Mounting

The shift in tone highlights the urgency Apple faces as it races to close the gap with AI leaders like OpenAI, Google, and Meta. Its new Apple Intelligence features, revealed at WWDC in June, are rolling out slowly, and Siri’s long-awaited generative AI upgrade isn’t expected until 2026.

Internally, some of Apple’s top AI talent has already defected to Meta. Externally, investors are watching competitors integrate AI across hardware and software ecosystems at a pace Apple has yet to match.

While Apple is boosting its own AI spending, Cook noted that capital expenditures are rising quarter over quarter due to AI investment, and building a fully in-house solution is a time-intensive process. And right now, Apple doesn’t have years to spare.

Election-year trade tensions add another wrinkle. With renewed tariff threats from former President Donald Trump, the cost of making iPhones could rise sharply. That could force Apple to increase hardware prices heading into the iPhone 17 cycle, adding further pressure to diversify its growth strategy.

Eyes on Perplexity AI

Cook’s new openness to acquisitions has reignited speculation about Perplexity AI, an AI-powered search startup that’s become one of the most talked-about names in Silicon Valley. Bloomberg previously reported that Apple held internal talks about acquiring Perplexity, which is currently valued at around $18 billion.

If that deal were to happen, it would eclipse Apple’s 2014 Beats acquisition by a wide margin. Historically, Apple has steered clear of multi-billion-dollar takeovers, but Cook’s remarks suggest the usual playbook may no longer apply.

That said, no deal has been confirmed, and Perplexity may still be a long shot. But the fact that Apple is even entertaining the idea of such a large buyout shows how seriously it’s taking its AI shortfall.

Cook’s Comments Widen the Door

When asked directly about Apple’s M&A strategy, Cook didn’t hedge:

“We’re very open to M&A that accelerates our roadmap. We’re not stuck on a certain size company. We basically ask ourselves whether a company can help us accelerate a roadmap. If they do, then we are interested.”

Coming from Apple, that’s a rare moment of directness. While no formal acquisition plans were announced, the message was unmistakable: the company is finally willing to spend big if the technology can justify the price.

If Apple does go forward with a landmark acquisition, this could end up being the moment where the company quietly signaled its next move.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

mainEntity.name: What does Head Tracked mean in Spatial Audio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

keyPoints.title: Apple's Shift in Acquisition Strategy
keyPoints.explanation: Apple is now open to large-scale acquisitions, especially to accelerate its AI ambitions, moving away from its traditional focus on smaller startup takeovers.

keyPoints.title: Rising AI Pressure and Competition
keyPoints.explanation: Faced with competition from AI leaders like OpenAI, Google, and Meta, Apple is ramping up its AI investment and slowly rolling out new AI features, but still lags behind in development pace.

keyPoints.title: Impact of External Factors on Hardware Costs
keyPoints.explanation: Trade tensions and tariff threats could increase iPhone manufacturing costs, potentially leading to higher hardware prices and pushing Apple to diversify its growth strategies.

keyPoints.title: Interest in Perplexity AI for a Potential Acquisition
keyPoints.explanation: Apple has shown interest in acquiring Perplexity AI, a highly-valued AI search startup, signaling a willingness to make bigger, more ambitious investments in AI technology.

keyPoints.title: Apple's New Openness to M&A and Future Moves
keyPoints.explanation: CEO Tim Cook’s comments indicate Apple is now willing to spend significantly on acquisitions that can accelerate its technological roadmap, hinting at possible major deals in the near future.

title.rendered: What Does Offload App Mean and How to Use It on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What does offload app mean: Offloading removes the app but keeps its data, freeing up space without losing personal info or app settings.
  • How to offload apps manually: Go to Settings > General > iPhone/iPad Storage, tap an app, then select Offload App to reclaim storage.
  • Set up automatic offloading: Enable Offload Unused Apps in Settings > App Store to let your device remove unused apps after inactivity.
  • How to reinstall an offloaded app: Tap the app’s icon or head to Settings > iPhone/iPad Storage > Reinstall App to restore it with full data.
  • Limitations and caveats: You can’t offload built-in apps like Safari or Photos, and offloaded apps require an internet connection to reinstall.

If you download a lot of apps and prefer storing media locally, you will eventually have to get rid of some to create enough space for new apps and media. When dealing with the former, Apple offers a handy feature called Offload Apps that lets you remove apps from your device without losing data. Let’s dive in to see what it really does and how you can use it to remove apps from your iPhone and iPad automatically.

What Does Offload App Mean on iPhone and iPad?

Let’s say you wish to remove an app that takes up considerable space on your iPhone or iPad. But you don’t want to lose the app data as it might contain important information. In this scenario, you can offload the app from your iPhone or iPad instead of deleting it.

The Offload App feature was introduced with iOS 11 to help you save local storage on your iPhone and iPad. When you use it to offload an app, it will remove it from your device without deleting any of its data. This way, when you need the app again, you can reinstall it, and it will be ready to use with all your app data reinstated.

Apple gives you the option to offload apps on your iPhone and iPad manually or automatically.

How to Offload Apps Manually on iPhone and iPad

If you have certain apps on your iPhone or iPad that you don’t use frequently but may need them occasionally, you can offload them manually. This is a great way to free up space instantly for those running very low on storage.

Here are the steps you need to follow:

  1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
  2. Tap General, go to iPhone/iPad Storage, and choose an app you want to offload from the list of apps installed on your iPhone.

  3. Tap on Offload App. When prompted to confirm, tap on Offload App again to confirm your choice.

How to Offload Apps Automatically on iPhone and iPad

If you don’t want to spend time offloading apps manually, Apple lets you set up the Offload App feature to run automatically. By doing so, you won’t have to keep checking your device storage regularly and decide what apps to remove, as the feature will automatically offload the apps that remain unused for more than 12 days on your device.

Here’s how to enable the feature:

  1. Open Settings, scroll down to the bottom, and select Apps.
  2. Select App Store and turn on the toggle for Offload Unused Apps.

Alternatively, you can go to Settings → General → iPhone/iPad Storage and tap on Enable next to Offload Unused Apps.

How to Download Offloaded Apps Again on iPhone and iPad

At any point in the future, if you need an app you offloaded previously, you can simply download it again. There are two ways to do this.

  • First, you can tap the app icon (with a cloud symbol next to it) on the Home Screen to download it.

  • Second, you can go to Settings → iPhone/iPad Storage, choose the app from the list, and tap Reinstall App.

Wrapping up

Unlike deleting, which completely deletes an app from your iPhone or iPad with all its data, offloading simply removes the app while preserving all its data on your local storage. As such, you can remove apps you use infrequently without worrying about losing your data.

However, keep in mind that you can’t offload all apps on your iPhone or iPad. While Apple does let you offload system apps, exceptions, like Photos, Safari, and Fitness, exist.

  • What is System Data on iPhone, and how to clear it
  • How to update an app on iPhone (Manually or automatically)

acceptedAnswer.text: You can’t with the native Files app, but third-party apps like iZip or WinZip let you add password protection to your ZIP files.

mainEntity.name: What types of files can be zipped?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost anything: photos, videos, PDFs, Word docs, presentations, and folders. Just make sure they're in the Files app.

mainEntity.name: Can I preview zipped files without extracting them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Long-press the ZIP file and tap Quick Look to peek inside without unzipping.

mainEntity.name: Is there a size limit for ZIP files on iOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technically no hard limit, but very large files (over 1GB) may slow down the device or fail depending on available space and memory.

acceptedAnswer.text: AirPods Pro ear tips are durable, but they don’t last forever. Daily use, earwax buildup, sweat, and environmental factors can degrade the silicone over time. It’s best to replace them when you notice wear, discomfort, or a drop in audio performance.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

mainEntity.name: What does Head Tracked mean in Spatial Audio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

mainEntity.name: Why is Dolby Atmos not showing in Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure Dolby Atmos is turned on by heading to Settings > Apps > Music. Also, ensure you're using compatible headphones and that you're playing a track labeled with the Dolby Atmos badge.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're different. Dolby Atmos gives you a 3D surround effect, while Lossless delivers higher sound quality. If your device and headphones support both, you can use both together.

@graph.name: How to manually update your carrier settings on your iPhone
@graph.description: Learn how to check and install carrier settings updates on your iPhone to enhance connectivity, support new features like 5G, and improve performance.

step.text: Open Settings on your iPhone.
Tap General, go to iPhone/iPad Storage, and choose an app you want to offload from the list of apps installed on your iPhone.
Tap on Offload App. When prompted to confirm, tap on Offload App again to confirm your choice.

@graph.name: How to Offload Apps Manually on iPhone and iPad
@graph.description: Free up space on your iPhone or iPad by manually offloading unused apps without deleting their data.

step.name: Open Settings and Access Storage
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad, tap General, then go to iPhone/iPad Storage and choose the app you want to offload.

itemListElement.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad.
Tap General from the list.
Select iPhone Storage or iPad Storage.
Scroll and choose the app you want to offload.

step.name: Offload the App
step.text: Tap Offload App and confirm your choice to remove the app while keeping its data.

itemListElement.text: Tap Offload App on the selected app's screen.
Tap Offload App again when prompted to confirm.

@graph.name: How to Offload Apps Automatically on iPhone and iPad
@graph.description: Free up storage on your iPhone or iPad by enabling automatic offloading of unused apps in just a few taps.

step.name: Go to Settings and open App Store
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad, scroll down, and tap on 'App Store'.

itemListElement.text: Launch the Settings app on your device.
Scroll down and select 'App Store'.

step.name: Enable Offload Unused Apps
step.text: Turn on the toggle next to 'Offload Unused Apps' to let your iPhone or iPad automatically remove unused apps when storage is low.

itemListElement.text: Find the option labeled 'Offload Unused Apps'.
Tap the toggle to turn it on.

@graph.name: How to Download Offloaded Apps Again on iPhone and iPad
@graph.description: Learn two simple ways to reinstall offloaded apps on your iPhone or iPad whenever you need them back.

step.name: Reinstall app from Home Screen
step.text: Look for the app icon with a small cloud symbol on your Home Screen and tap it to begin the download.

itemListElement.text: Find the app icon with a cloud symbol on your Home Screen.
Tap the icon to redownload the app.

step.name: Reinstall app via iPhone Storage settings
step.text: Go to Settings, tap General, then iPhone/iPad Storage. Select the app and tap 'Reinstall App' to bring it back.

itemListElement.text: Open Settings and go to General.
Tap on iPhone Storage or iPad Storage.
Scroll through the list and select the app you want to reinstall.
Tap the 'Reinstall App' option.

properties.name: How to manually update your carrier settings on your iPhone
properties.description: Learn how to check and install carrier settings updates on your iPhone to enhance connectivity, support new features like 5G, and improve performance.

steps.text: Tap General, go to iPhone/iPad Storage, and choose an app you want to offload from the list of apps installed on your iPhone.
Tap on Offload App. When prompted to confirm, tap on Offload App again to confirm your choice.

keyPoints.title: Understanding Offload App on iPhone and iPad
keyPoints.explanation: Offloading an app removes it without deleting its data, allowing for storage space savings while keeping important information intact for future use.

keyPoints.title: Manual Offloading of Apps
keyPoints.explanation: You can manually offload apps via Settings > General > iPhone/iPad Storage, selecting the app, and choosing 'Offload App' to free up space.

keyPoints.title: Automatic Offloading Setup
keyPoints.explanation: Enable 'Offload Unused Apps' in Settings > App Store or iPhone/iPad Storage settings to automatically offload apps unused for more than 12 days.

keyPoints.title: Reinstalling Offloaded Apps
keyPoints.explanation: Offloaded apps can be re-downloaded by tapping the cloud icon or through Settings > iPhone/iPad Storage > Reinstall App, restoring all data seamlessly.

keyPoints.title: Limitations and Considerations of Offloading
keyPoints.explanation: Not all apps can be offloaded, especially system apps like Photos or Safari, but this feature helps manage storage without data loss for supported apps.

title.rendered: Mac keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes: The ultimate guide

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Why Use Shortcuts: Using keyboard shortcuts in Apple Notes on your Mac significantly speeds up your note-taking workflow.
  • Basic Actions: Use basic shortcuts like `Command+N` for new notes and `Command+D` to duplicate them quickly.
  • Formatting Text: Quickly format notes with shortcuts like `Shift+Command+H` for headings and `Command+B` for bold text.
  • Advanced Navigation: Use `Command+F` to find text and other shortcuts to easily create and navigate tables in notes.
  • Custom Shortcuts: Create your own shortcuts for any menu command via System Settings for a fully personalized workflow.

Apple Notes is an easy-to-use note-taking app for keeping and organizing your thoughts and ideas on a Mac. If you use it extensively, you must take advantage of its various keyboard shortcuts to elevate your note-taking experience. These shortcuts let you edit, format, and organize notes faster, saving you the hassle of navigating menus for simple tasks.

Below, we’ve curated a list of essential Mac keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes. We’ll also show you how to create custom shortcuts for Apple Notes on a Mac. Keep reading to find out!

Table of Contents
  • Best keyboard shortcuts for Notes app on Mac
    • Basic shortcuts for everyday use in Apple Notes
    • Note editing and formatting shortcuts
      • Searching and filtering
      • Table shortcuts
    • Customizing keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes on Mac

    Best keyboard shortcuts for Notes app on Mac

    While you can find keyboard shortcuts for most functions in the Apple Notes menu bar, we’ve rounded up some of the most important ones for easy reference.

    Basic shortcuts for everyday use in Apple Notes

    • Create a new note: Command+N
    • Create a new Quick Note: Fn+Q (works anywhere on your Mac for quick access to Notes, as long as you haven’t changed the keyboard settings)
    • Duplicate a note: Command+D
    • Create a new folder: Shift+Command+N
    • Show or hide folders/sidebar: Command+Option+S
    • Show the main Notes window: Command+0 (Zero)
    • Move between the sidebar, notes list, and search field: Tab (this doesn’t work if you’re currently editing a note)
    • Show notes in a list: Command+1
    • Show notes in gallery view: Command+2
    • Show attachments: Command+3
    • Attach a file: Shift+Command+A
    • Link a note: >>
    • Print a note: Command+P
    • Delete a note: Command+Delete (click the note you want to delete before using the shortcut)
    • Quit the Notes app: Command+Q

    Note editing and formatting shortcuts

    Formatting

    • Apply Title format: Shift+Command+T
    • Apply Heading format: Shift+Command+H
    • Apply Subheading format: Shift+Command+J
    • Apply Body format: Shift+Command+B
    • Apply Monostyled format: Shift+Command+M
    • Apply Bulleted List format: Shift+Command+7
    • Apply Dashed List format: Shift+Command+8
    • Apply Numbered List format: Shift+Command+9
    • Apply Block Quote format: Command+’
    • Apply Checklist format: Shift+Command+L

    Font size and color

    • Show Fonts window: Command+T
    • Bold text: Command+B
    • Italic text: Command+I
    • Underline text: Command+U
    • Increase font size: Command+Plus sign
    • Decrease font size: Command+Minus sign
    • Show Color window: Shift+Command+C

    List

    • Increase list level: Command+] or Tab
    • Decrease list level: Command+[ or Shift+Tab
    • Add a line break (soft return) to a list item or checklist: Shift+Return
    • Insert a tab character in a list item: Option+Tab
    • Mark or unmark a checklist item: Shift+Command+U
    • Move a list or checklist item up in the list: Control+Command+Up Arrow
    • Move a list or checklist item down in the list: Control+Command+Down Arrow

    Other formatting shortcuts

    • Create a link: Command+K
    • Select an emoji: Control+Command+Space
    • Copy style: Option+Command+C
    • Paste style: Option+Command+V
    • Show spelling and grammar: Command+Shift+: (the Shift key is included in this shortcut to press : instead of 😉
    • Zoom in on note’s contents: Shift+Command+>
    • Zoom out on note’s contents: Shift+Command+<
    • Change size of note’s contents to default: Shift+Command+0 (Zero)

    Searching and filtering

    • Find in currently opened note: Command+F
    • Find in all notes: Option+Command+F
    • Find next: Command+G
    • Find previous: Shift+Command+G
    • Use selection for find: Command+E
    • Jump to selection: Command+J

    Table shortcuts

    • Insert a table: Option+Command+T
    • Add a row above the current one: Option+Command+Up Arrow
    • Add a row below the current one: Option+Command+Down Arrow
    • Add a column to the right: Option+Command+Right Arrow
    • Add a column to the left: Option+Command+Left Arrow
    • Move down a row or create a new row at the bottom: Return
    • Move up a row or exit the table when at the first row: Shift+Return
    • Go to the next cell on the right: Tab
    • Go to the previous cell on the left: Shift+Tab
    • Insert a new paragraph inside a cell: Option+Return
    • Insert a tab character in a cell: Option+Tab
    • Select cells across a row: Shift+Left Arrow or Shift+Right Arrow
    • Select cells across a column: Shift+Up Arrow or Shift+Down Arrow
    • Highlight the content of the current cell: Command+A
      (If not inside the table, this shortcut selects the entire note.)
    • Highlight the entire table: Command+A (press twice)
      (If not inside the table, pressing Command+A selects the entire note.)

    Customizing keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes on Mac

    Some functions in the Notes app, like the Lock Note menu or the Check Spelling While Typing menu, don’t have keyboard shortcuts by default. However, you can create your own keyboard shortcuts for these. Here’s how:

    1. Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your Mac and select System Settings.

    2. Select Keyboard from the sidebar, scroll down, and click Keyboard Shortcuts.

    3. Choose App Shortcuts from the left, then click the + icon under All Applications.

    4. Click the drop-down button next to Application and select Notes as the app you want to create a shortcut for.
    5. In the Menu Title field, type the exact command leading to the menu you want to assign a keyboard shortcut for as it appears in the Notes app. For example, if you want to create a shortcut for the Check Spelling While Typing menu, you need to enter: Edit->Spelling and Grammar->Check Spelling While Typing. Remember to use a hyphen before the ‘>’ symbol with no spaces in between each menu, and ensure the menu title matches exactly as it appears in the app.
    6. Click the Keyboard Shortcut field, press the key combination you want to assign, and then click Done.

    Similarly, you can also customize existing shortcuts if the default options aren’t convenient for you.

    Discover essential resources to help you unlock your Mac’s full potential!

    1. Ultimate Guide to Mac Option Key—This comprehensive guide covers all the hidden features and shortcuts of the Mac option key, helping you use it like a pro.
    2. 300+ Mac Keyboard Shortcuts for Beginners and Pros – Master your Mac with over 300 keyboard shortcuts designed to boost your productivity and make your workflow seamless.

    Get them both now on Gumroad and level up your Mac experience!

    Signing off…

    The shortcuts above should have you covered on most fronts and reduce dependence on the mouse or Trackpad in the Notes app, especially for trivial actions. So go ahead and develop a command over them to improve your workflow in the Notes app on your Mac.

    Also read:

    • Why is my MacBook keyboard not working, and how can I fix it?

    • How to Control F on iPhone
    • Everything New for Apple Notes in iOS 27

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. @graph.name: How to Customize Keyboard Shortcuts for Apple Notes on Mac
@graph.description: Learn how to create custom keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes on Mac by configuring app-specific shortcuts in System Settings.

step.name: Open System Settings
step.text: Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your Mac and select System Settings.

itemListElement.text: Click the Apple logo in the menu bar.
Select System Settings from the drop-down menu.

step.name: Access Keyboard Shortcuts
step.text: Select Keyboard from the sidebar, scroll down, and click Keyboard Shortcuts.

itemListElement.text: Click Keyboard in the left sidebar.
Scroll down and select Keyboard Shortcuts.

step.name: Create a new app shortcut
step.text: Choose App Shortcuts from the left, then click the plus (+) icon under All Applications.

itemListElement.text: Select App Shortcuts from the left panel.
Click the + icon to add a new shortcut.

step.name: Set Notes as the target app
step.text: Click the Application drop-down button and select Notes as the app you want to create a shortcut for.

itemListElement.text: Click the Application menu.
Select Notes from the list.

step.name: Enter the exact menu command
step.text: In the Menu Title field, type the exact command path from the Notes menu. For example, enter: Edit->Spelling and Grammar->Check Spelling While Typing, ensuring it matches exactly.

itemListElement.text: Type the full command path exactly as it appears in Notes.
Use a hyphen before the '>' with no spaces.

step.name: Assign your shortcut
step.text: Click the Keyboard Shortcut field, press your desired key combination, and click Done to save.

itemListElement.text: Click the Keyboard Shortcut field.
Press the desired key combination.
Click Done to save.

keyPoints.title: Essential Mac keyboard shortcuts for Apple Notes
keyPoints.explanation: Using shortcuts in Apple Notes can significantly speed up your workflow, allowing quick access to creating, editing, and organizing notes without navigating menus.

keyPoints.title: Basic shortcuts for everyday actions
keyPoints.explanation: Common shortcuts like Command+N for new notes, Command+D to duplicate, and Command+Q to quit help streamline routine tasks efficiently.

keyPoints.title: Note editing and formatting shortcuts
keyPoints.explanation: Keyboard shortcuts such as Shift+Command+T for title, Shift+Command+H for headings, and Command+B for bold make formatting notes fast and easy.

keyPoints.title: Searching, filtering, and table navigation shortcuts
keyPoints.explanation: Quickly find text within notes with Command+F, manage tables with options like Option+Command+T to insert tables, and navigate cells with Tab or Shift+Tab.

keyPoints.title: Customizing shortcuts for unavailable functions
keyPoints.explanation: You can create your own keyboard shortcuts for menu commands missing default shortcuts via System Settings, allowing personalized and efficient workflows.

title.rendered: Apple ProRAW on iPhone: How to Shoot Like a Pro

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What is ProRAW?: ProRAW merges RAW file data with Apple’s image processing, offering maximum editing flexibility.
  • Device Compatibility: ProRAW is exclusively available on iPhone 12 Pro and all newer Pro models, including the 16 Pro.
  • How to Enable: Enable ProRAW by navigating to Settings > Camera > Formats and toggling on the Apple ProRAW option.
  • How to Shoot: Once enabled, tap the “RAW” button in the Camera app to turn the feature on or off.
  • Identifying RAW Photos: RAW photos are clearly marked with a “RAW” tag at the top of the image in the Photos app.

If you love iPhone photography, you might have noticed the ‘RAW’ option in your Camera app but never bothered to try it. Here’s why you should—and exactly how to shoot Apple ProRAW photos on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is Apple ProRAW?
  • Which iPhones Support ProRAW?
  • How to Enable Apple ProRAW
  • How to Shoot with Apple ProRAW on iPhone
  • Are RAW Photos Flagged in the Photos App?
  • Things to Remember When Shooting Apple ProRAW
  • Why Should You Use Apple ProRAW?

What is Apple ProRAW?

Normally, when you take a photo on your iPhone, it’s saved as a JPEG or HEIC. These photos appear bright, sharp, and ready to share because your iPhone edits them automatically. But the downside is that you can’t edit them much later, as most details are compressed or permanently altered in the file.

RAW photos work differently. They retain all the original data from the camera sensor without any edits. This gives you full freedom to adjust brightness, shadows, or colors exactly how you want. However, RAW photos can initially look flat or dull since they don’t include Apple’s smart processing.

This is where Apple ProRAW comes in. It combines the best of both worlds:

  • You get full, unedited RAW data for maximum editing flexibility.
  • Plus, Apple’s image processing enhances detail, color, and dynamic range right from the start.

In simple words: ProRAW gives you a RAW photo with Apple’s magic touch already added, so you get a great-looking image that you can still fine-tune to match your unique style.

Which iPhones Support ProRAW?

Only Pro models support shooting in Apple ProRAW:

  • iPhone 12 Pro / Pro Max
  • iPhone 13 Pro / Pro Max
  • iPhone 14 Pro / Pro Max
  • iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max

How to Enable Apple ProRAW

Before you can shoot in ProRAW, you need to enable it:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Go to Camera > Formats.
  3. Turn on Apple ProRAW or ProRAW & Resolution Control.

Once it’s enabled, you’ll see a RAW button in your Camera app.

Also Read: 10 Best iPhone Camera Settings for Stunning Photos

How to Shoot with Apple ProRAW on iPhone

Here’s how to capture a ProRAW photo on your iPhone:

  1. Open the Camera app.
  2. Tap the RAW button at the top to turn it on.
  3. Frame your shot and tap the shutter button.

You can tap the RAW button anytime to toggle it on or off before capturing. If you have an iPhone 14 Pro or newer, you can choose between 12MP and 48MP ProRAW photos. Long-press the RAW button to select your preferred resolution.

Are RAW Photos Flagged in the Photos App?

After capturing a photo, you may want to confirm if it was shot in RAW. To check:

  1. Open the Photos app and tap on the image.
  2. You won’t see the RAW label in the thumbnail view, but when you open the photo fully, you’ll find a RAW tag at the top.

Apps like Adobe Lightroom make this even easier by showing a DNG sticker on RAW photos directly in the thumbnail view, making them easier to identify for editing.

Things to Remember When Shooting Apple ProRAW

  • ProRAW photos are large, typically 20MB to 90MB, so they can quickly consume your storage.
  • You can’t use ProRAW with Portrait mode or Live Photos.
  • ProRAW works on all rear cameras and the front camera.
  • Night mode and macro shots using the Ultra-Wide camera on iPhone 16 Pro can also support ProRAW at up to 48MP.
  • ProRAW photos may look flat at first—editing is required. Use the Photos app for basic tweaks or Lightroom for full control.
  • ProRAW files are saved in .DNG format.
  • You can export them via iCloud, AirDrop (select All Photos Data), or transfer using Image Capture or the Photos app on Mac/PC.

Why Should You Use Apple ProRAW?

ProRAW is a powerful tool that turns your iPhone into a pro-level camera. Use it when you want the best image quality and full editing control. Since it retains all the details, you can fine-tune lighting, color, and tone even after the shot.

It’s ideal for landscape photography, night shots, or scenes with both shadows and highlights, where preserving every detail is essential. For casual photos, food pics, or selfies meant for quick sharing, JPEG is still the fastest option.

Related articles worth reading:

  • How to Take Long-Exposure Photos on iPhone
  • How to Capture Spatial Photos and Videos on iPhone

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

mainEntity.name: What does Head Tracked mean in Spatial Audio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

mainEntity.name: Why is Dolby Atmos not showing in Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure Dolby Atmos is turned on by heading to Settings > Apps > Music. Also, ensure you're using compatible headphones and that you're playing a track labeled with the Dolby Atmos badge.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're different. Dolby Atmos gives you a 3D surround effect, while Lossless delivers higher sound quality. If your device and headphones support both, you can use both together.

step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone.

keyPoints.explanation: ProRAW is supported on iPhone 12 Pro and newer Pro models, including the iPhone 13 Pro, 14 Pro, 15 Pro, and 16 Pro series.

keyPoints.title: How to Enable Apple ProRAW
keyPoints.explanation: Enable ProRAW via Settings > Camera > Formats by toggling on Apple ProRAW, after which a RAW button appears in the Camera app.

keyPoints.title: How to Shoot with Apple ProRAW on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: Open the Camera app, tap the RAW button to turn it on, and tap the shutter to capture a ProRAW photo, with options for resolution on newer models.

keyPoints.title: Are RAW Photos Flagged in the Photos App?
keyPoints.explanation: RAW photos can be identified in the Photos app by opening the image where a RAW tag appears at the top, with third-party apps like Lightroom showing a DNG sticker.

author.description: I’ve been writing about tech for over 5 years, with 1000+ articles published so far. From iPhones and MacBooks to Android phones and AI tools, I’ve always enjoyed turning complicated features into simple, jargon-free guides. Recently, I switched sides and joined the Apple camp. Whether you want to try out new features, catch up on the latest news, or tweak your Apple devices, I’m here to help you get the most out of your tech.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio: With over 5 years of hands-on tech writing experience and more than 900 published articles, I’ve explored the best of Apple, Android, and Chrome OS. From iPhones and MacBooks to Pixel devices and Chromebooks, I break down complex features into simple, relatable guides—minus the jargon. Whether you’re customizing your iPhone, troubleshooting your Android, or tweaking Chrome OS settings, my goal is to help you get more out of your tech.

title.rendered: How to Limit or Turn Off Instagram DMs for More Privacy

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Default DM Settings: By default, anyone on Instagram can send you DMs; you must adjust privacy settings to change this.
  • Why Limit DMs: Users often disable or limit DMs to avoid spam, prevent harassment, and reduce unwanted online distractions.
  • How to Limit DMs: You can manage DMs by blocking message requests, disabling story replies, or preventing unwanted group adds.
  • Block vs. Restrict: Blocking stops all contact; restricting sends their DMs to message requests without notifying you.
  • Gentler Options: For a gentler approach, mute conversations to stop notifications or use “Close Friends” for story replies.

Direct messages on Instagram are a great way to connect with your friends and followers, but they do have some associated privacy concerns. There are instances where you may feel overwhelmed by spam or unsolicited messages popping up in your chat feed. While Instagram doesn’t let you disable DMs altogether, there are effective ways to block, restrict, or mute them based on your preferences.

This post details every possible way to manage, limit, or silence your Instagram inbox.

Table of Contents
  • Understanding Instagram Direct Messages
  • Why You Might Want to Turn Off Instagram DMs
  • How to Limit or Turn Off DMs on Instagram?
    • 1. Adjust Message Settings to Block New Requests
    • 2. Turn Off Story Replies
    • 3. Stop People from Adding You to Group Chats
    • 4. Restrict or Block an Account
    • 5. Mute Messages and Calls
    • 6. Use “Close Friends” to Limit Story DMs
  • How to Report Spam or Harassment in DMs on Instagram

Understanding Instagram Direct Messages

Direct messages on Instagram are one-to-one or group conversations between users on the platform. Users can send text, photos, videos, voice messages, and even disappearing media.

By default, anyone with an Instagram account can send you a DM on the platform unless you configure the following settings:

  • Your account type: Public or Private
  • Your follower/following relationship
  • Your message controls (set under privacy settings)
  • Cross-platform connections, such as Facebook friends

Why You Might Want to Turn Off Instagram DMs

Even though Instagram DMs help you stay connected, they can sometimes feel invasive. Here’s why many users choose to restrict or silence them:

  • Avoid Spam and Bots: Public profiles often receive spam, promotional messages, or phishing links.
  • Reduce Distractions: Constant DM alerts can disturb your focus or workflow.
  • Boost Privacy: Limiting DMs gives you more control over who can contact you.
  • Prevent Harassment: If you’re targeted with inappropriate messages, blocking or restricting DMs becomes a safety necessity.

How to Limit or Turn Off DMs on Instagram?

Let’s explore different ways you can control who gets to message you on Instagram:

1. Adjust Message Settings to Block New Requests

Anyone you follow or have messaged before can send you new DMs. But you can stop message requests from strangers. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Instagram app and head to your profile.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Scroll down and tap Messages and Story Replies.
  4. Select Message Requests under the “How people can reach you” section.
  5. Next, choose Your followers on Instagram or No one under the “Who can send you message requests” section.

This stops new message requests from unknown users while keeping current conversations intact.

2. Turn Off Story Replies

Instagram Stories are a major entry point for unsolicited DMs. You can disable story replies to reduce the noise:

  1. Open the Instagram app and head to your profile.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Tap Messages and Story Replies → Story Replies.
  4. Select Don’t allow story replies.

This prevents both emoji reactions and typed responses from cluttering your DM feed.

3. Stop People from Adding You to Group Chats

Tired of getting dragged into random group messages? Here’s how to fix that:

  1. Open Instagram → Profile → Tap the hamburger icon.
  2. Tap Messages and Story Replies → Message Requests.
  3. Select People you follow under the “Who can send you group message requests” section.

This setting limits group chat invites only to those you follow.

4. Restrict or Block an Account

If someone keeps messaging you—even someone you follow—you’ll need to block or restrict them.

To block a user from messaging:

  1. Visit their profile.
  2. Tap the three-dot button.
  3. Select Block.

To restrict a user from messaging:

  1. Visit their profile.
  2. Tap the three-dot menu.
  3. Select Restrict.

Blocked users can’t see your content or message you. Restricted users can send messages, but they land in Message Requests, and you won’t get notified.

5. Mute Messages and Calls

If blocking feels too harsh, muting is a gentler way to regain peace:

  1. Open the Instagram DM thread and tap the person’s name at the top.
  2. Tap the Mute (bell icon) button.
  3. Toggle on Mute messages and Mute calls.
  4. Also, toggle on “Hide message previews” if you don’t want the message previews to appear in push notifications.

6. Use “Close Friends” to Limit Story DMs

Want to keep sharing Stories without getting flooded with replies? Use the Close Friends feature.

When you post a Story only for Close Friends:

  • Only selected users can see it.
  • Story replies are limited to that small circle.

Fewer viewers = fewer unwanted DMs.

How to Report Spam or Harassment in DMs on Instagram

Blocking alone isn’t enough if someone is harassing you. Help Instagram take action by reporting the behavior.

  1. Open the Instagram DM thread and tap the person’s name at the top.
  2. Tap the three-dot menu.
  3. Select the Report option and follow the on-screen instructions.

Control DMs on Your Terms

You don’t need to delete your Instagram account or go fully private just to stop spammy or annoying messages. A few smart tweaks in your DM settings can bring peace to your digital space. Take five minutes today and implement the steps above to enjoy a cleaner inbox and more meaningful connections.

FAQs

Can I still see old messages after turning off DMs?

Yes, you can still see old messages after turning off DMs. Blocking, restricting, or limiting who can message you only affects new incoming messages.

Can I limit DMs without going private?

Yes, you can block message requests from strangers and followers while keeping your profile public.

Is there a way to auto-delete DMs?

Instagram doesn’t offer a built-in feature to automatically delete regular DMs. However, you can use Vanish Mode in one-on-one chats, and messages sent in this mode disappear once they are viewed and the chat is closed.

Will someone know if I muted or restricted them?

No, Instagram does not notify the person when you restrict them.

Do Story replies count as DMs?

Yes, Story replies on Instagram count as direct messages. Even an emoji reaction to a Story is counted as a DM.

  • How to download Reels in Instagram on iPhone

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

mainEntity.name: What does Head Tracked mean in Spatial Audio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

mainEntity.name: Why is Dolby Atmos not showing in Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure Dolby Atmos is turned on by heading to Settings > Apps > Music. Also, ensure you're using compatible headphones and that you're playing a track labeled with the Dolby Atmos badge.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're different. Dolby Atmos gives you a 3D surround effect, while Lossless delivers higher sound quality. If your device and headphones support both, you can use both together.

mainEntity.name: Can I still see old messages after turning off DMs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can still see old messages after turning off DMs. Blocking, restricting, or limiting who can message you only affects new incoming messages.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can block message requests from strangers and followers while keeping your profile public.

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram doesn't offer a built-in feature to automatically delete regular DMs. However, you can use Vanish Mode in one-on-one chats, and messages sent in this mode disappear once they are viewed and the chat is closed.

blockGraphs.question: Can I still see old messages after turning off DMs?
blockGraphs.answer: Yes, you can still see old messages after turning off DMs. Blocking, restricting, or limiting who can message you only affects new incoming messages.

blockGraphs.question: Can I limit DMs without going private?
blockGraphs.answer: Yes, you can block message requests from strangers and followers while keeping your profile public.

blockGraphs.question: Is there a way to auto-delete DMs?
blockGraphs.answer: Instagram doesn't offer a built-in feature to automatically delete regular DMs. However, you can use Vanish Mode in one-on-one chats, and messages sent in this mode disappear once they are viewed and the chat is closed.

blockGraphs.question: Will someone know if I muted or restricted them?
blockGraphs.answer: No, Instagram does not notify the person when you restrict them.

blockGraphs.question: Do Story replies count as DMs?
blockGraphs.answer: Yes, Story replies on Instagram count as direct messages. Even an emoji reaction to a Story is counted as a DM.

keyPoints.title: Understanding Instagram Direct Messages
keyPoints.explanation: DMs on Instagram are one-to-one or group conversations allowing users to send texts, photos, videos, and disappearing media, with default settings permitting anyone to message unless specific privacy controls are configured.

keyPoints.title: Reasons to Turn Off Instagram DMs
keyPoints.explanation: Users may restrict or silence DMs to avoid spam, reduce distractions, enhance privacy, or prevent harassment, especially when receiving unwanted or unsolicited messages.

keyPoints.title: How to Limit or Disable DMs on Instagram
keyPoints.explanation: Options include adjusting message settings to block requests from strangers, turning off story replies, preventing adds to group chats, restricting or blocking accounts, muting messages and calls, and using 'Close Friends' for story DMs.

keyPoints.title: Restricting or Blocking Users
keyPoints.explanation: Blocking a user prevents them from seeing your content or messaging you, while restricting allows them to message but their messages land in message requests without notifications.

keyPoints.title: Managing DMs for Peace of Mind
keyPoints.explanation: Muting messages and calls is a gentle way to stop notifications, and using 'Close Friends' limits reply access, helping users manage their inbox without fully disabling DMs.

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Why I Turned Off Google AI Overviews and How You Can Too

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Google AI Overviews often include errors or outdated info, and many users find they reduce the quality and usefulness of search results.
  • Disabling AI Overviews restores classic search layouts by removing summaries that can bury original sources and clutter the top of the page.
  • On desktop, use browser extensions or tweaks like ‘Hide Google AI Overviews’ or search setting changes to bypass AI-generated content.
  • Mobile workarounds include TenBlueLinks on Chrome or custom search engines in Firefox to block AI Overviews from loading.
  • These fixes give you more control over your search results and avoid depending on Google’s timeline for improving AI accuracy.

Gone are the days of saying, “See? I’m right because Google says so.”

For a while now, users have been complaining that search quality has taken a hit. And just when things couldn’t get more frustrating, Google added a giant AI-generated box to the top of almost every results page.

Sure, the answers have improved since the early apply glue-on-pizza days. But they’re still often outdated, confusing, or flat-out wrong. And even when they’re close, I still find myself fact-checking them.

So here’s the question: if I’m going to double-check everything anyway, why not just skip the AI and go straight to the real results? That’s exactly what I did.

I turned off AI Overviews — and honestly, it felt like getting the old Google back. Here’s how you can do the same.

What Are AI Overviews in Google Search?

If you haven’t noticed yet, for most searches on Google now, you’ll likely see an AI Overview section at the top of the results. It’s an auto-generated summary that uses AI to pull pieces of information from various web pages and stitch them into one box.

Sounds helpful, right? The reality is often different.

These summaries frequently pull from outdated or questionable sources—including social media—and sometimes even hallucinate completely incorrect answers.

Why You Might Want to Turn Off AI Overviews

Here’s why many people (myself included) are opting out:

  • It sounds confident, even when it’s wrong. AI mixes real info with made-up stuff so smoothly that you might not notice unless you already know better.
  • It often shows outdated results. I saw it pulling year-old info for things that change quickly, like stock market news or current world records.
  • Real content—blogs, forums, expert sites—gets pushed way down. You have to scroll past AI fluff to find anything useful.
  • There’s no true “off” switch. Even disabling Search Labs doesn’t fully remove it.
  • It hurts creators. Google shows a summary instead of sending you to the sites that wrote the content.
  • It doesn’t actually save time. I still verify everything, so what’s the point?

How to Turn Off Google AI Overviews on Desktop

There’s no official “off” switch yet—but there are a couple of easy workarounds.

Method 1: Use a Browser Extension

Install the Hide Google AI Overviews Chrome extension from the Web Store. Once it’s active, AI Overviews will disappear from your search results.

It works on Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers, such as Brave and Edge. No need to tweak any other settings.

If you use Firefox, there’s a version for that too, made by the same developer. 

The AI summary still loads in the background, but at least you won’t have to see it. Sometimes, the AI overview appears as a second result instead of the first; in such cases, this extension may struggle to hide it in such cases, but overall, it’s a simple and effective solution. 

Method 2: Manual Search Engine Tweak (No Extension Required)

If you don’t want to use a third-party extension, or you use Safari or any other browser that does not have a proper extension, you can hide the AI overview yourself manually by modifying the default search URL. To do that, 

  1. Open Chrome and go to: chrome://settings/searchEngine. Alternatively, you can open Chrome Settings > Search Engine.
  2. Scroll to Site Search and click Add.
  3. Fill out:
    • Name: AI-Free Google
    • Shortcut: @web
    • URL: {google:baseURL}search?q=%s&udm=14
  4. After adding, click the three dots next to it > Make Default.

From now on, your searches will skip the AI Overview and go straight to the classic web results.

This redirects your searches to the “Web” tab of Google, skipping the AI Overview. But heads-up: it also removes sections like People Also Ask, videos, Images, and Info from the Knowledge Graph and Forums. You get the classic 10 blue links—and that’s it.

How to Disable Google AI Overviews on Mobile

Blocking AI Overviews on iPhone and Android is slightly more complicated, but still possible.

Option 1: Use TenBlueLinks on Chrome

  1. Open Chrome and visit tenbluelinks.org.
  2. Open a new tab and search for anything on Google. Don’t skip this step.
  3. Tap on the three-dot menu in the bottom right corner. (Top right corner on Android).
  4. Choose Settings in the pop-up.
  5. In Settings, select the Search Engine option.
  6. Select Google Web in the Recently visited section.
  7. Finally, tap Done to set Google Web as your default search engine.

That’s it. Your searches now default to the Web tab, just like on desktop. As mentioned, this also removes “People Also Ask,” forum discussions, videos, etc., from the search results and only gives you 10 blue links.

Option 2: Firefox Custom Search Engine

You can also add a custom search engine in Firefox:

  1. Open the Firefox app on your phone.
  2. Tap the three–dot menu in the top right corner and go to Settings.
  3. Tap Search.
  4. Then tap Add Search Engine.
  5. In the Title field, type: AI-Free Google.
  6. In the Search String URL field, paste: https://www.google.com/search?udm=14&q=%s
  7. Tap Save.
  8. Now go back to the search engine list, tap Default Search Engine, and select the one you just created.

That’s it. You can remove AI Overviews by simply switching to a custom search engine. However, most other mobile browsers don’t currently support this method.

You Deserve Better Answers

Google Search is no longer what it used to be. AI Overviews try to summarize the web for you, but end up getting in the way more often than not.

If you want your search experience to feel trustworthy again, you don’t have to wait for Google to fix it. You can take back control right now.

I did it — and now you know how to do it too.

  • How to Turn Off Google Trending Searches on Any Device
  • Google Maps Can Now Scan Your iPhone Screenshots to Save Locations
  • How to Set Preferred Sources on Google Search
  • How to Use Google Lens on iPhone or iPad

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

mainEntity.name: What does Head Tracked mean in Spatial Audio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

mainEntity.name: Why is Dolby Atmos not showing in Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure Dolby Atmos is turned on by heading to Settings > Apps > Music. Also, ensure you're using compatible headphones and that you're playing a track labeled with the Dolby Atmos badge.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're different. Dolby Atmos gives you a 3D surround effect, while Lossless delivers higher sound quality. If your device and headphones support both, you can use both together.

mainEntity.name: Can I still see old messages after turning off DMs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can still see old messages after turning off DMs. Blocking, restricting, or limiting who can message you only affects new incoming messages.

@graph.name: How to Disable Google AI Overviews on Mobile (Use TenBlueLinks on Chrome)
@graph.description: Want the classic Google results back? Here’s how to disable AI Overviews on mobile Chrome using TenBlueLinks and bring back the old search layout.
supply: Mobile device with Google Chrome browser installed

step.name: Visit TenBlueLinks
step.text: Open Chrome on your mobile device and visit tenbluelinks.org.

itemListElement.text: Launch Chrome on your phone.
Type tenbluelinks.org into the address bar and open the site.

step.name: Search something
step.text: Open a new tab and search for anything using Google Search. This helps activate TenBlueLinks.

itemListElement.text: Open a new tab in Chrome.
Search for any random term like 'weather' or 'news'.

step.name: Open Chrome Settings
step.text: Tap the three-dot menu in the bottom right on iOS or top right on Android, then choose Settings.

itemListElement.text: Tap the menu icon (three dots) based on your device.
Select Settings from the dropdown.

step.name: Change search engine
step.text: In the Settings menu, tap Search Engine and choose Google Web from the Recently visited section.

itemListElement.text: Tap on Search Engine in the Settings list.
Under Recently visited, select Google Web.
Tap Done to confirm your selection.

@graph.name: How to Disable Google AI Overviews on Mobile (Use Firefox Custom Search Engine)
@graph.description: Don’t like Google's AI Overviews on mobile? Here's how to switch back to classic search results using a custom search engine in Firefox.
supply: Mobile device with Firefox browser installed
tool: Custom Google Search URL with UDM=14 parameter

step.name: Open Firefox Settings
step.text: Launch Firefox and tap the three-dot menu in the top right corner to open Settings.

itemListElement.text: Open the Firefox app on your phone.
Tap the three-dot icon in the top right corner.
Select Settings from the menu.

step.name: Navigate to Search Settings
step.text: From the Settings menu, tap Search to view your browser’s search engine options.

itemListElement.text: Scroll down in Settings and tap Search.

step.name: Add Custom Search Engine
step.text: Tap Add Search Engine and fill in the title and search string to create your custom engine.

itemListElement.text: Tap Add Search Engine at the bottom.
In the Title field, enter: AI-Free Google.
Paste this in the Search String URL field: https://www.google.com/search?udm=14&q=%s
Tap Save to finish adding the engine.

step.name: Set Custom Engine as Default
step.text: Return to the search engine list, tap Default Search Engine, and choose AI-Free Google.

itemListElement.text: Go back to the main Search settings screen.
Tap Default Search Engine.
Select AI-Free Google from the list.

keyPoints.title: Understanding Google AI Overviews
keyPoints.explanation: AI Overviews are auto-generated summaries at the top of Google search results that often source outdated or questionable information, sometimes even hallucinating incorrect answers.

keyPoints.title: Reasons to Disable AI Overviews
keyPoints.explanation: Many users prefer to turn off AI Overviews because they can be misleading, outdated, push down real content, and do not truly save time, affecting both search quality and content creators.

keyPoints.title: Turning Off AI Overviews on Desktop
keyPoints.explanation: You can disable AI Overviews using browser extensions like 'Hide Google AI Overviews' or by manually tweaking search settings to bypass these summaries and get traditional web results.

keyPoints.title: Blocking AI Overviews on Mobile Devices
keyPoints.explanation: On mobile, options include using tools like TenBlueLinks on Chrome to set Google Web as the default search engine or creating custom search engines in Firefox to avoid AI Overviews.

keyPoints.title: Taking Control of Your Search Experience
keyPoints.explanation: Users can improve their trust in search results by disabling AI Overviews, reclaiming space for real content, and making their search experience more trustworthy without waiting for Google to fix these issues.

title.rendered: How to Use Perplexity AI to Generate Images on WhatsApp

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What It Is: Perplexity AI on WhatsApp is a chatbot that provides real-time answers and generates AI images from prompts.
  • How It Works: The AI uses models like DALL·E 3 to understand your text prompts and generate corresponding images.
  • Getting Started: To begin, save the AI’s contact number or use a direct link, then simply start chatting.
  • Refining Images: You cannot directly edit images, but you can refine them by sending new, more descriptive prompts.
  • Limitations & Safety: Image quality varies and usage may be limited; avoid sharing sensitive information for your own privacy.

Ever since its inception, Perplexity AI has quickly gained attention as a powerful conversational search tool. However, did you know it also features a WhatsApp chatbot? That’s right — Perplexity AI can not only answer your questions and search queries, but it can also generate AI images from your chat prompts.

If you’re curious about how to access Perplexity AI on WhatsApp and generate high-quality images, you’re in the right place. Continue reading to learn how.

Table of Contents
  • What Is Perplexity AI on WhatsApp?
  • How Does Image Generation Work in Perplexity AI?
  • How to Set Up and Use Perplexity AI on WhatsApp
  • Can You Regenerate or Refine Images?
  • Limitations to Keep in Mind
  • Is It Safe to Use?

What Is Perplexity AI on WhatsApp?

Perplexity AI on WhatsApp is an advanced AI chatbot and search engine designed to deliver factual, conversational answers in real time. You can save Perplexity AI’s number to your contacts and chat with it like you would with a friend.

Moreover, you can ask the Perplexity AI chatbot to generate AI images based on the prompts you send in the chat, similar to how you use the ChatGPT chatbot on WhatsApp.

How Does Image Generation Work in Perplexity AI?

To generate images in the WhatsApp chat, Perplexity AI uses its multimodal AI capabilities, consisting of natural language understanding and powerful image generation models. Moreover, based on the complexity of the prompt you send, it sometimes uses generation tools like DALL·E or Stable Diffusion to create custom images from your prompts.

All you need to do is provide a detailed description of what you want in your image, and Perplexity AI will do the rest.

How to Set Up and Use Perplexity AI on WhatsApp

Before you can generate images, you need to connect with Perplexity AI on WhatsApp. Here’s how:

  1. Open WhatsApp and tap the “+” button at the top right corner.
  2. Tap the Search Bar at the top, enter “+1 (833) 436-3285,” and tap the Perplexity AI contact tab to begin chatting.
  3. Alternatively, tap this link: wa.me/18334363285 to open Perplexity AI directly on WhatsApp, or save the official Perplexity number to your contacts.

Now that you have access to the chat, you can generate images. Here’s how:

  1. Type a clear description of what you want in the text box.
  2. Hit Send to create images.

Example prompts:

  • Generate an image of a futuristic cityscape at sunset.
  • Show me a watercolor painting of a panda riding a bicycle.
  • Create an AI image of an astronaut exploring a purple alien planet.

Within seconds, Perplexity will send back the AI-generated image in response to your request.

Tap Download Now to save the image to your phone’s gallery.

Can You Regenerate or Refine Images?

As of now, Perplexity AI on WhatsApp does not offer any direct image editing tools. However, if the generated image isn’t up to the mark, you can send another prompt with updated details in the chat, such as:

  • “Make it more colorful”
  • “Add mountains in the background”

Perplexity AI understands context, so follow-up prompts usually work well.

Limitations to Keep in Mind

While Perplexity AI’s image generation on WhatsApp is impressive, it’s still in its early stage and comes with a few limitations:

  • Image quality may vary based on prompt clarity.
  • File format is usually JPEG or PNG, with limited resolution options.
  • No bulk or batch image generation is currently available.
  • You may be rate-limited if you send too many image prompts in a short time.

Is It Safe to Use?

Yes, the Perplexity AI chatbot on WhatsApp is officially verified and secure. Like every other WhatsApp chat, any message you send or receive in the Perplexity AI chat is end-to-end encrypted.

However, even though it’s safe to use, you should refrain from:

  • Sharing personal or sensitive information in prompts.
  • Using the AI to generate inappropriate or copyrighted content.

The responsibility to use AI ethically and responsibly lies with you.

The Future of AI in Messaging

The addition of image generation capabilities to the Perplexity AI chatbot on WhatsApp offers a glimpse into the future, where messaging, creativity, and artificial intelligence merge seamlessly. With AI just a message away, you don’t need to install any dedicated apps on your phone.

Share your best AI-generated image or prompt idea in the comments below. Let’s inspire creativity together.

Related articles worth reading:

  • WhatsApp Gets Smarter on iPhone with Threaded Replies and AI Wallpapers
  • How to Use Apple Image Playground to Create AI Art on iPhone

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.
