mainEntity.name: Can I create password-protected ZIP files on iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can’t with the native Files app, but third-party apps like iZip or WinZip let you add password protection to your ZIP files.

mainEntity.name: What types of files can be zipped?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost anything: photos, videos, PDFs, Word docs, presentations, and folders. Just make sure they're in the Files app.

mainEntity.name: Can I preview zipped files without extracting them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Long-press the ZIP file and tap Quick Look to peek inside without unzipping.

mainEntity.name: Is there a size limit for ZIP files on iOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technically no hard limit, but very large files (over 1GB) may slow down the device or fail depending on available space and memory.

mainEntity.name: How often should you replace AirPods Pro tips?

acceptedAnswer.text: AirPods Pro ear tips are durable, but they don’t last forever. Daily use, earwax buildup, sweat, and environmental factors can degrade the silicone over time. It’s best to replace them when you notice wear, discomfort, or a drop in audio performance.

mainEntity.name: How often should I clean AirPods Pro tips?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maintain hygiene and sound quality, clean your AirPods Pro ear tips at least once a week. Regular cleaning helps prevent buildup that can affect fit and performance.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an Xbox console to use Xbox Cloud Gaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can stream directly from Microsoft servers using a Game Pass Ultimate subscription.

mainEntity.name: Is Xbox Game Pass Ultimate Required?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for Cloud Gaming. The Xbox Game Pass Ultimate gives you access to 100+ games to stream, including EA Play and day-one Xbox Studio titles. Remote Play does not need a Game Pass, just the Xbox app and a console.

mainEntity.name: Does Xbox Remote Play work over cellular?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but performance may drop. Use 5GHz Wi-Fi or strong 5G for better results.

mainEntity.name: Will using a controller drain my iPhone battery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slightly. Bluetooth uses some power, but it’s minimal compared to screen brightness and network usage. A full charge before a session is recommended.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

mainEntity.name: What does Head Tracked mean in Spatial Audio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

mainEntity.name: Why is Dolby Atmos not showing in Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure Dolby Atmos is turned on by heading to Settings > Apps > Music. Also, ensure you're using compatible headphones and that you're playing a track labeled with the Dolby Atmos badge.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're different. Dolby Atmos gives you a 3D surround effect, while Lossless delivers higher sound quality. If your device and headphones support both, you can use both together.

mainEntity.name: Does closing apps save battery on Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, no. Since watchOS suspends apps automatically, closing them rarely affects battery life unless one is misbehaving.

mainEntity.name: Can I close all apps at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You must close each app individually, either via the App Switcher or by force quitting it.

keyPoints.title: Universal Control Overview
keyPoints.explanation: Universal Control allows users to control multiple Apple devices, like Mac and iPad, from a single mouse and keyboard, enabling seamless cursor movement, typing, and drag-and-drop across devices.

keyPoints.title: System Requirements for Universal Control
keyPoints.explanation: To use Universal Control, devices must run macOS Monterey 12.4+ or iPadOS 15.4+ within 30 feet, share the same Apple ID with two-factor authentication, and have Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and Handoff enabled.

keyPoints.title: Enabling Universal Control on Devices
keyPoints.explanation: On Mac, enable it through System Settings > Displays > Advanced, and on iPad, turn on Cursor and Keyboard in Settings > General > AirPlay & Continuity.

keyPoints.title: Using Universal Control Day-to-Day
keyPoints.explanation: Connect devices by lining them up, move the cursor to the screen edge, and the pointer merges onto the second device; you can then type, drag files, and use gestures across devices.

keyPoints.title: Tips & Troubleshooting
keyPoints.explanation: Optimize Universal Control by arranging displays properly, using Gestures, or combining with Sidecar; troubleshoot issues by checking OS versions, connection settings, or disabling VPNs if needed.

title.rendered: How to Use Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Accessibility Shortcut offers instant access to tools like VoiceOver, AssistiveTouch, or Magnifier by triple-clicking the Side or Home button.
  • Shortcut speeds up navigation by giving you fast, system-wide toggles for selected accessibility features without digging into Settings.
  • Especially helpful for users with disabilities including vision, hearing, motor, or cognitive challenges, and for anyone who prefers simplified control.
  • You can enable it in multiple ways including through Settings, Siri, or by assigning it to the Action Button on newer iPhone models.
  • Customize and reorder shortcut options to prioritize the features you use most, making the menu faster and more personal.

Apple’s Accessibility Shortcut is a powerful tool designed to make iPhones and iPads easier to use for everyone, especially users with diverse accessibility needs. With just a few taps or gestures, you can instantly access features like VoiceOver, Magnifier, AssistiveTouch, and more. In iOS 26, Apple has enhanced accessibility even further with new features that make navigating your device even more intuitive.

In this guide, I’ll cover what the Accessibility Shortcut is, how to enable it, and how to use it effectively on your iPhone or iPad.

Table of Contents
  • What is the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad?
  • Why Use the Accessibility Shortcut?
  • Who Can Benefit from the Accessibility Shortcut?
  • How to Turn On Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad
    • Using the Settings App
    • Using Siri
    • Assign to the Action Button
  • Customizing the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad
    • Select Multiple Accessibility Options
    • Reorder Shortcut Options
  • Popular Accessibility Features to Add to the Shortcut
    • VoiceOver
    • Magnifier
    • AssistiveTouch
    • Color Filters
  • How to Use Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad
    • Method 1: Triple-Click Side or Home Button
    • Method 2: From Control Center
    • Method 3: Use Back Tap
    • Method 4: Vocal Shortcuts
  • What's New in iOS 26 Accessibility?
  • How to Turn Off Accessibility Shortcuts
  • Troubleshooting Accessibility Shortcut Not Working
  • Best Practices for Accessibility Shortcut

What is the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad?

The Accessibility Shortcut offers a fast and convenient way to toggle accessibility features on or off without digging through menus. Simply triple-click the Side or Home button, and you’ll instantly access tools like VoiceOver, Magnifier, or Assistive Access.

You can also activate these features using Siri, Control Center, Back Tap, or Vocal Shortcuts, depending on your preferred method. The shortcut brings essential tools to your fingertips, enhancing ease of use and personalization.

Why Use the Accessibility Shortcut?

This shortcut isn’t just for users with disabilities—it’s designed for anyone seeking faster, easier control over iOS accessibility tools.

Here’s why it’s helpful:

  • Efficient access: Quickly turn features on/off with one gesture.
  • Customizable: Choose which features appear in the shortcut.
  • Multimodal control: Activate features via physical buttons, voice, or touch.
  • System-wide impact: Improve device usability in various scenarios, from reading fine print to navigating with limited mobility.

Who Can Benefit from the Accessibility Shortcut?

The Accessibility Shortcut is ideal for:

  • Visually impaired users: Use VoiceOver or Magnifier to navigate the screen.
  • Users with motor limitations: AssistiveTouch and Switch Control simplify interactions.
  • Hearing-impaired individuals: Tools like Live Listen and Sound Recognition enhance audio accessibility.
  • People with cognitive challenges: Guided Access and Assistive Access create a more focused interface.
  • Everyday users: Anyone can use features like Background Sounds or Color Filters for convenience or visual comfort.

How to Turn On Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad

You can set up the Accessibility Shortcut in several ways:

Using the Settings App

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad. 
  2. Tap Accessibility.
  3. Scroll down and tap Accessibility Shortcut.
  4. You’ll see a list of features like Assistive Access, AssistiveTouch, Background Sounds, etc. Select the ones you want to include in the shortcut. A checkmark will appear next to selected features. 
  5. Tap the Back button to save.

Using Siri

Activate features hands-free:

  • Say, “Hey Siri, turn on [accessibility name].” For example, say, “Hey Siri, turn on VoiceOver” to enable it instantly. 

Assign to the Action Button

On supported iPhone models (like the iPhone 15 Pro or later), you can assign the Accessibility Shortcut to the Action button: 

  1. Go to Settings > Action Button. 
  2. Select Accessibility from the list of options. 
  3. Choose a specific feature (e.g., Magnifier) or the Accessibility Shortcut menu. 
  4. Press and hold the Action button to activate.

Customizing the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad

You can fine-tune the Accessibility Shortcut menu for personalized access.

Select Multiple Accessibility Options

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Accessibility Shortcut. 
  2. Tap each feature you want to include, such as VoiceOver, Magnifier, and Color Filters. A checkmark indicates they’re selected. 
  3. If you select multiple features, triple-clicking the Side or Home button will open a menu where you can choose which one to activate. 

Reorder Shortcut Options

  1. In the Accessibility Shortcut menu, tap and drag the handle (three lines) next to each feature to reorder them.

     
  2. The order determines how features appear in the shortcut menu. For example, placing VoiceOver at the top makes it the first option you see when you triple-click.

Popular Accessibility Features to Add to the Shortcut

Here are some of the most commonly used accessibility features you can assign to the shortcut. 

VoiceOver

VoiceOver is a screen reader that describes what’s on your screen, making it ideal for users with visual impairments. It reads text, app icons, and notifications aloud.

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > VoiceOver. 
  2. Toggle on VoiceOver and adjust settings like speaking rate, speech, or verbosity. 

  3. Once added to the Accessibility Shortcut, triple-click to toggle it on or off. 

Magnifier 

The Magnifier tool turns your device’s camera into a magnifying glass, helping you zoom in on small text or objects. It also includes a Reader Mode in iOS 26 for easier text reading.

To use: 

  1. Add Magnifier to the Accessibility Shortcut or Control Center. 
  2. Triple-click or select it to open the app and adjust zoom levels or lighting. 

AssistiveTouch

AssistiveTouch creates an on-screen menu to replace physical button presses or gestures, making it perfect for individuals with motor challenges. It allows you to perform actions such as taking screenshots or locking the screen with a single tap.

To set up: 

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Touch > AssistiveTouch and turn it on. 
  2. Select Customize Top Level Menu to include actions you use most.

  3. You can also assign custom actions to Double-Tap or Long Press. 

Color Filters 

Color Filters adjust the screen’s colors to help users with color blindness or visual sensitivities. Options include grayscale, red/green filters, or custom tints. To enable: 

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Color Filters. 
  2. Toggle on Color Filters, choose a filter, and drag the Intensity slider. 

iOS also offers several other useful Accessibility features, including Hover Typing, Control Nearby Devices, Live Captions, and Vehicle Motion Cues.  

How to Use Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad

You can activate the shortcut in various ways:

Method 1: Triple-Click Side or Home Button

  • Triple-click Side button (Face ID models) or Home button (older models).
  • If one feature is selected, it toggles on/off. If multiple, a menu appears.

Method 2: From Control Center 

  1. Open Control Center by swiping down from the top right corner. 
  2. Tap the + button at the bottom and select Add a Control.  
  3. Search and select Accessibility Shortcuts. You can also select individual accessibility features, such as Magnifier or Live Captions, but this may clutter your Control Center. 

  4. Now, you can tap the control to activate it. 

Method 3: Use Back Tap 

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Back Tap. 
  2. Select Double Tap or Triple Tap and choose Accessibility Shortcut or a specific feature. 

  3. Tap the back of your iPhone twice or three times to activate. 

Method 4: Vocal Shortcuts

You can create custom commands to activate features with Vocal Shortcuts.

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Vocal Shortcuts. 
  2. Tap Set Up Vocal Shortcuts > Continue and select Accessibility Shortcut.

     
  3. Now, enter a custom phrase (e.g., “Open Shortcut”) to trigger it. 
  4. Say the phrase 3 times to activate the feature hands-free.

What’s New in iOS 26 Accessibility?

Apple continues to raise the bar for inclusive technology. iOS 26 introduces:

  • Accessibility Nutrition Labels: App Store now highlights supported accessibility features.
  • Braille Access: Take notes and do calculations using Nemeth Braille.
  • Accessibility Reader: A system-wide mode that simplifies reading in any app.

These updates ensure everyone can enjoy the iPhone or iPad, regardless of ability.

How to Turn Off Accessibility Shortcuts

To disable features:

  1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Accessibility Shortcut. 
  2. Tap to uncheck all features, removing them from the shortcut. 
  3. You can also turn off specific features in their respective menus (e.g., Settings > Accessibility > VoiceOver > toggle off). 
  4. If assigned to the Action button or Back Tap, go to those settings and choose a different action or set to None. 

Troubleshooting Accessibility Shortcut Not Working

Try these fixes if you run into issues:

  1. Triple-click not responding: Go to Settings > Accessibility > Side Button (or Home Button) and adjust the click speed to Slow or Slowest. 

  2. Feature conflicts: Certain features, such as VoiceOver and Switch Control, may not work well together. Disable conflicting features in the Accessibility Shortcut menu. 
  3. Expected feature not available: Some features, such as Guided Access, must be enabled separately: Settings > Accessibility > Guided Access. 
  4. Siri not activating features: Ensure Siri is enabled (Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri) and your device isn’t in Assistive Access mode, which limits some shortcuts. 
  5. Shortcut not appearing: Verify that at least one feature is selected in Settings > Accessibility > Accessibility Shortcut. 
  6. General issues: Restart your device or update to the latest iOS version (Settings > General > Software Update). 

Best Practices for Accessibility Shortcut

  • Add only essential features to reduce menu clutter.
  • Explore activation options (triple-click, Back Tap, Siri) to find what suits you.
  • Customize individual feature settings for better usability.
  • Use Control Center for one-tap activation.
  • Keep iOS updated to access the latest accessibility improvements.

Simplify Your Device Experience with Accessibility Shortcut

The Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad is one of the most underrated yet powerful features in iOS. Whether you need it for everyday convenience or to assist with a specific challenge, this tool makes your device more inclusive, personal, and intuitive.

FAQs

Can I use more than one feature with the Accessibility Shortcut?

Yes. When you select multiple tools, a menu appears on triple-click to choose the one you need.

Can I assign the shortcut to a different button or gesture?

Yes. Use Back Tap, the Action button, or create Vocal Shortcuts.

What if my triple-click doesn’t respond?

Slow down the click speed in Settings > Accessibility > Side/Home Button, and ensure at least one feature is selected.

Does this shortcut drain the battery?

Not much. However, features like VoiceOver or Magnifier may use more power. Disable them when not in use.

You would like to read these posts as well:

  • How to Use the Shortcuts App on iPhone and iPad
  • How to Use Memoji on iPhone and iPad Pro
  • How to use Accessibility Shortcut on Apple Watch

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, no. Since watchOS suspends apps automatically, closing them rarely affects battery life unless one is misbehaving.

mainEntity.name: Can I close all apps at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You must close each app individually, either via the App Switcher or by force quitting it.

mainEntity.name: Why do apps keep running in the background?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most apps do not continue running in the background. WatchOS suspends them automatically and only allows brief refreshes for essential updates.

mainEntity.name: Can I use more than one feature with the Accessibility Shortcut?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. When you select multiple tools, a menu appears on triple-click to choose the one you need.

mainEntity.name: Can I assign the shortcut to a different button or gesture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use Back Tap, the Action button, or create Vocal Shortcuts.

mainEntity.name: What if my triple-click doesn't respond?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slow down the click speed in Settings > Accessibility > Side/Home Button, and ensure at least one feature is selected.

mainEntity.name: Does this shortcut drain the battery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not much. However, features like VoiceOver or Magnifier may use more power. Disable them when not in use.

@graph.name: How to Turn On Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone Using the Settings App
@graph.description: Quickly enable the Accessibility Shortcut on your iPhone to toggle features like AssistiveTouch or Background Sounds with a triple-click.

step.name: Open Settings
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad.

itemListElement.text: Open the Settings app from your Home Screen.

step.name: Go to Accessibility
step.text: Tap Accessibility to view the available accessibility features.

itemListElement.text: Scroll down and tap Accessibility.

step.name: Choose Accessibility Shortcut
step.text: Scroll down and tap Accessibility Shortcut to see the list of toggleable features.

itemListElement.text: Scroll to the bottom and tap Accessibility Shortcut.

step.name: Select Features
step.text: Tap the features you want to add to the shortcut. A checkmark will appear next to each selected one.

itemListElement.text: Select one or more features like AssistiveTouch or Background Sounds.

step.name: Save Your Selection
step.text: Tap the Back button to confirm and save your selected shortcut options.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Back button to save your changes.

@graph.name: How to Customize the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone or iPad
@graph.description: Easily modify or disable the Accessibility Shortcut on your iPhone or iPad by selecting which features it activates or turning it off entirely.

step.name: Open Accessibility Shortcut Settings
step.text: Go to Settings, tap Accessibility, then tap Accessibility Shortcut.

itemListElement.text: Open the Settings app and go to Accessibility.
Scroll down and tap Accessibility Shortcut.

step.name: Remove All Features from Shortcut
step.text: Tap each feature to uncheck and remove it from the Accessibility Shortcut.

itemListElement.text: Tap to deselect any features you don't want in the shortcut.

step.name: Turn Off Individual Features
step.text: Go to each feature’s menu under Accessibility and toggle them off if no longer needed.

itemListElement.text: For example, go to VoiceOver under Accessibility and toggle it off.

step.name: Change Action Button or Back Tap Settings
step.text: If the shortcut is tied to the Action button or Back Tap, go to their settings and assign a different action or set it to None.

itemListElement.text: Go to Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Back Tap or Settings > Action Button.
Choose a new action or set it to None to disable the shortcut.

keyPoints.title: What is the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad?
keyPoints.explanation: It is a quick method to toggle accessibility features like VoiceOver, Magnifier, or AssistiveTouch by triple-clicking the Side or Home button, making device usage more convenient.

keyPoints.title: Why Use the Accessibility Shortcut?
keyPoints.explanation: This shortcut provides faster, customizable, and system-wide control over accessibility tools, enhancing ease of access and personalized device experience.

keyPoints.title: Who Can Benefit from the Accessibility Shortcut?
keyPoints.explanation: It is designed for visually impaired, motor-limited, hearing-impaired, cognitively challenged users, and anyone seeking simpler device controls.

keyPoints.title: How to Enable the Accessibility Shortcut?
keyPoints.explanation: You can activate it via Settings, Siri, assigning to the Action Button on supported models, or customizing which features appear in the shortcut menu.

keyPoints.title: Customizing Features in the Shortcut
keyPoints.explanation: Users can select multiple accessibility options and reorder them for quick access, tailoring the shortcut to their needs.

title.rendered: Apple’s India Manufacturing May Push iPhone 17 Prices Higher

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • New 25% U.S. tariff hits Indian iPhones and may drive up iPhone 17 prices by $50 or more for American buyers.
  • India now Apple’s only short-term option as China’s high tariffs and logistics hurdles limit alternatives for iPhone assembly.
  • Apple faces a tough pricing dilemma between raising iPhone 17 prices or absorbing costs that shrink profit margins.
  • Production shifts may speed up post-2025 with Apple likely expanding iPhone manufacturing in Vietnam and Brazil for long-term stability.
  • Expect potential delays and cost bumps if Apple can’t pivot quickly, especially for iPhone 17 units meant for the U.S. market.

Apple’s long-term strategy to shift iPhone manufacturing out of China and into India could now face a costly setback. A steep new U.S. tariff on Indian imports, set to take effect August 1, threatens to undercut Apple’s efforts just as iPhone 17 production ramps up.

25% Tariff Could Directly Impact U.S. iPhone 17 Pricing

iPhones assembled in India have so far been subject to a 10% import tariff when shipped to the U.S., already more than triple the 3% Apple paid before the U.S.-China trade war reshaped global supply chains. But barring a last-minute deal between Washington and New Delhi, that rate is poised to spike to 25%.

The tariff escalation stems from policies originally initiated during former President Trump’s administration. Trump, who remains vocal about trade terms, recently stated there’s still no agreement in place and criticized India for what he called some of the world’s highest tariff barriers.

The timing is especially problematic. Apple has spent years building out Indian production lines, and the country now accounts for roughly one-fifth of global iPhone shipments. A significant portion of those units are destined for U.S. consumers. Analysts estimate up to $40 billion worth of iPhones could be affected by the new 25% rate.

Production Constraints Leave Apple With Few Options

There’s little Apple can do in the short term to shift production elsewhere. The idea of quickly rerouting U.S.-bound iPhone manufacturing is more complicated than it sounds. American assembly is logistically and economically unfeasible, and despite recent investments in stateside facilities, the broader component supply chain remains deeply rooted in Asia.

Switching back to China isn’t viable either. iPhones shipped to the U.S. from Chinese factories would face even steeper tariffs of around 55% in some cases. That made India the preferred workaround. But with the new rate on the table, Apple’s backup plan is looking far less stable.

Tariffs Threaten to Squeeze Margins or Hike Prices

The new tariff could arrive just as iPhone 17 units begin shipping for the U.S. market. Production for the launch is already underway, and any devices arriving stateside after August 1 would be subject to the increased duty unless a bilateral agreement is reached in time.

That leaves Apple with an uncomfortable decision: absorb the added cost or pass it on to consumers. Neither route is painless. Apple’s profit margins have already been hit by rising component prices and currency pressures. Raising sticker prices on the iPhone 17 lineup could alienate upgrade-hesitant buyers, especially with inflation-weary consumers already feeling the pinch.

Talks between the U.S. and Indian governments are expected to resume in mid-August, with a possible agreement emerging by September or later. But for Apple, that may come too late. The initial wave of iPhone 17 shipments will likely bear the brunt of the new import cost.

Related: iPhone 17 Price Hike Could Make All Models $50 More Expensive

Diversification Could Accelerate After iPhone 17 Launch

In the near term, Apple will likely maintain its course in India, there’s no near-term alternative that can match its scale. But this episode underscores the vulnerability of relying on a single fallback to China. It may accelerate Apple’s diversification efforts, with Vietnam, Brazil, and other Southeast Asian countries becoming stronger candidates for future assembly growth.

For U.S. buyers, the most immediate impact could be felt at checkout. A $100 price increase across the iPhone 17 lineup, while speculative, isn’t out of the question given the math on a 25% tariff hike. That kind of jump could hit entry-level buyers hardest and complicate Apple’s premium-tier upgrade strategy.

Apple’s customer base remains loyal, but pricing is never immune to pushback, especially when driven by geopolitical forces rather than product innovation.

Would a price hike stop you from upgrading this year? Tell us what you think in the comments.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

title.rendered: macOS 26 Tahoe: How to Change Folder Icons Using Emojis, Symbols, or Colors

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • macOS 26 Tahoe adds native folder customization with emoji, color, or symbol options—no need for Preview or third-party apps anymore.
  • You can change icons with just a control-click on any folder, then pick from emoji, symbols, or icon packs, with search and reset built in.
  • Changes sync across your Apple devices if iCloud is enabled, making personalized folders consistent on Mac, iPad, and iPhone.
  • Older macOS versions still need workarounds like Preview editing or third-party tools for icon changes, especially for custom images.
  • Use clean, high-contrast icons for visibility in Light and Dark Modes, and keep folder labeling clear to avoid clutter or confusion.

With macOS 26 Tahoe, Apple has introduced a faster and more intuitive way to change folder icons using emojis, symbols, or built-in color packs. Whether you want to make a folder pop with a bright emoji or give it a minimal, professional symbol, the process is now seamless and doesn’t require third-party apps.

In this guide, I’ll show you how to customize folder icons on your Mac running macOS 26 Tahoe, with step-by-step instructions. I’ll also cover how to do it on older versions, such as macOS Sequoia, share best practices, and troubleshoot common issues.

Table of Contents
  • Why Customize Folder Icons on Mac?
  • What's New in macOS 26 Tahoe for Folder Customization?
  • How to Change Folder Icons on macOS 26 Tahoe
    • Method 1: Use Emojis for Folder Icons
    • Method 2: Use Symbols for a Sleek Look
    • Method 3: Apply Built-in Color Packs
  • How to Reset Folder Icons on macOS 26 Tahoe
  • How to Change Folder Icons on macOS Sequoia or Earlier
    • Method 1: Use Preview to Change Folder Colors
    • Method 2: Use Third-party Folder Customization Apps
  • Can You Use Custom Images or Icons on Mac Folders?
  • Best Practices for macOS Folder Customization
  • Can't Change Folder Icon Colors on Mac? Try These Fixes
  • Find Folders Quickly with Colors and Emoji Icons

Why Customize Folder Icons on Mac?

Customizing folder icons isn’t just for aesthetic appeal—it boosts productivity too. Here’s how:

  • Spot folders faster: A red folder for urgent projects or a plane emoji for travel plans helps you locate them instantly.
  • Better organization: Emojis and color codes can visually group folders by theme, such as work, personal, hobbies, and more.
  • Express yourself: Add a creative or professional touch that reflects your personality or workflow.

macOS 26 Tahoe makes all of this easier with built-in tools—no external software needed.

What’s New in macOS 26 Tahoe for Folder Customization?

Apple has redesigned the folder customization experience in macOS 26.

Here’s what’s new:

  • Control-click a folder to quickly access color tags and built-in icon packs with emojis or symbols.
  • You can find the emoji by describing it in the search bar.
  • Choose from built-in icon packs that blend with Tahoe’s Liquid Glass UI.
  • Sync folder icons across devices via the Files app on iOS and iPadOS 26.
  • One-click reset lets you revert to the default macOS blue folder icon.

How to Change Folder Icons on macOS 26 Tahoe

You can use emojis, symbols, or color tags to give your folders a unique look.

Method 1: Use Emojis for Folder Icons

Perfect for a fun and bold design, emojis act like stickers on your folders.

  1. Open Finder and navigate to the folder you want to customize.
  2. Control-click the folder to open the context menu.
  3. In the menu, select Customize Folder (below the color tag options). A customization window will pop up with options for colors, symbols, and emojis.

  4. Click the Emoji button at the bottom right of the customization window.

  5. A panel with emojis will appear with a search bar at the top.
  6. Click the emoji you want, and it will appear as a colorful sticker on the folder.

  7. Click anywhere to close the window and save the emoji. Your folder now shows the new icon!

To modify it later, just repeat the steps and choose another emoji.

Related: How to Find Out What Emojis Mean on iPhone

Method 2: Use Symbols for a Sleek Look

Symbols appear etched or embossed into the folder, creating a more refined and professional appearance.

  1. In Finder, Control-click the folder you want to change and select Customize Folder from the menu.


  2. In the customization window, you’ll see a list of built-in icon packs.
  3. Scroll through the list to pick one. Unlike emojis, there’s no search bar, so take your time to browse.
  4. Click a symbol to preview it in the folder. It will appear carved into the surface of the folder.


  5. Click outside anywhere to apply the symbol. Your folder now has a tidy’ embossed icon.

Method 3: Apply Built-in Color Packs

Quick and efficient, color tags help visually distinguish folders without adding icons.

  1. Control-click the folder in Finder.
  2. In the context menu, you’ll see colored dots (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Gray).


  3. Click a color to apply it instantly. The folder changes to that shade.

You can’t set custom colors here, but combining a color tag with an emoji or symbol gives even more visibility.

Tip: Want to change color of your all folders? Simply, go to System Settings > Appearance > dropdown next to Folder color and select a color tag. Now, you will see folder icons across your system to converted to that color.

How to Reset Folder Icons on macOS 26 Tahoe

Need to revert a folder to its original look? Here’s how:

  1. Control-click the folder and select Customize Folder.
  2. Click the Clear button at the bottom left of the customization window.


  3. The folder reverts to its standard look.
  4. If you have assigned a color tag, click on it again to remove it.

How to Change Folder Icons on macOS Sequoia or Earlier

Older versions don’t offer built-in customization like Tahoe. But you can still change folder icons using Preview or third-party apps.

Method 1: Use Preview to Change Folder Colors

  1. Launch the Finder app → right-click on the folder.
  2. Select Get Info.

  3. Click the folder icon on the top left of the [folder name].

  4. Press Cmd (⌘) + C to copy the icon.

  5. Launch Preview using Spotlight (Cmd (⌘) + spacebar).

  6. From the menu bar, select File → pick New from Clipboard.

  7. Click the Markup tool (the pencil icon).

  8. Navigate to the Adjust Color (the settings icon).

  9. Alter the color by adjusting the tint sliders until you find your desired shade.

  10. Click the X icon to close the dialogue box.

  11. Select the colored folder and copy it by pressing Cmd (⌘) + C → Click the X icon.
  12. Choose Delete from the dialogue box.

  13. Head back to the Info window from the start. If you’ve closed it, return to the folder → right-click → select Get Info.
  14. Select the folder icon in the Info window and press Cmd (⌘) + V.

Third-party apps are a good choice if you’re considering altering your folder color on your Mac. I’ve curated a list of some of the most popular options below.

  1. Folder Color: This software allows you to modify the color of individual folders and create custom folder icons.

Yes, you can. But instead of pasting directly on the folder, you need to follow a detailed process. Check out our guide to changing app and folder icons on Mac for full instructions.

Best Practices for macOS Folder Customization

Keep things organized with these helpful tips:

  • Customize only key folders to make them stand out.
  • Group folders by theme, like travel (plane emoji, blue color) or finances (money symbol, green color).
  • Too many unique icons can confuse you. Stick to a few colors or emojis for clarity.
  • Ensure icons are clear in both Light and Dark modes, as Tahoe’s Liquid Glass look can affect appearance.
  • Use emojis or symbols for folders you access on other Apple devices, as custom images won’t sync.

  • If you’ve used the new Customize Folder option, clear it first to use the Get Info method for custom images.
  • Customize Folder not showing? Ensure you’re running macOS 26 Tahoe and have a stable internet connection for emoji loading.
  • Colors not applying? Only color-based tags work for folders. Non-color tags (e.g., Work) won’t change the icon.
  • Icons look blurry? For custom images, use high-resolution PNGs for sharp results.

With the new folder customization tools in macOS 26 Tahoe, personalizing your Mac has never been easier. Whether you add playful emojis, sharp symbols, or bold colors, each folder becomes more than just storage—it becomes part of your workflow and expression.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. @graph.name: How to Use Preview to Change Folder Colors
@graph.description: Learn how to customize your Mac folder icons with different colors using the built-in Preview app for a more personalized and organized workspace.

supply.name: Mac with Finder and Preview apps

step.name: Open folder info
step.text: Launch the Finder app and right-click on the folder you want to recolor, then select Get Info.

itemListElement.text: Right-click the folder you want to edit.
Click Get Info from the menu.

step.name: Copy the folder icon
step.text: Click the folder icon in the top-left of the Info window and press Command (⌘) + C to copy it.

itemListElement.text: Click the small folder icon at the top-left of the Info window.
Press Command (⌘) + C to copy the folder icon.

step.name: Open the icon in Preview
step.text: Open Preview using Spotlight, then from the menu bar select File and choose New from Clipboard.

itemListElement.text: Use Spotlight (Command + Space) to launch Preview.
In Preview, click File and choose New from Clipboard.

step.name: Change the folder color
step.text: Click the Markup tool, then the Adjust Color icon. Move the tint sliders to customize the folder color as you like.

itemListElement.text: Click the Markup tool in the Preview window.
Click the Adjust Color icon, which looks like a settings dial.
Adjust the tint and color sliders until you're happy with the result.

step.name: Apply the new icon
step.text: Copy the newly colored folder icon, close the window, then return to the Info window and paste it over the original icon.

itemListElement.text: Press Command (⌘) + C to copy the updated folder icon.
Close Preview and return to the original Info window.
Click the folder icon in the Info window and press Command (⌘) + V to paste the new icon.

title.rendered: Google AI Can Guess Your Age and Restrict Your Account

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Google’s AI age check replaces user birthdays by analyzing search and watch behavior, aiming to detect minors without relying on self-declared birthdates.
  • Accounts flagged as teens get auto-restricted with no location tracking, limited app downloads, fewer recommendations, and no personalized ads across Google services.
  • Mistaken age flags trigger ID verification via credit card, selfie, or government ID, raising concerns about privacy and user burden to regain full access.
  • Regulatory pressure is driving the rollout as Google aligns with UK and US laws requiring stricter age verification for digital platforms and content.
  • Algorithmic age guessing faces ethical questions around transparency, bias, and limiting user access based on behavioral profiling without direct human review.

Google is rolling out a new AI system in the U.S. that estimates users’ ages based on behavior, replacing the self-reported birthdates people enter when creating an account. The change is part of a broader push to enforce age-appropriate restrictions across Google services, but it introduces a host of new privacy and accuracy concerns.

Instead of trusting users to be honest about their age, a system Google acknowledges is often gamed by younger users, the company will now rely on signals such as search queries, YouTube viewing habits, and potentially other undisclosed data points to infer whether someone is under 18. If the system believes a user is a minor, it will automatically apply safety restrictions across their account.

What Happens When Google Flags You as a Teen

Accounts flagged by the AI as belonging to users under 18 will be shifted into a “teen mode.” This mirrors the experience for users who explicitly register their age as underage:

  • YouTube will start surfacing fewer recommendations and enable bedtime reminders by default.
  • Google Maps will disable Timeline tracking, cutting off access to location history.
  • Google Play Store will block downloads for apps marked as adult or mature.
  • Ads will no longer be personalized, removing behavior-based targeting.

For now, only a small number of U.S. accounts will see these changes. But if the system performs as expected, Google plans to scale it more broadly across its ecosystem.

What If Google Gets It Wrong?

Google admits the system won’t be perfect. An adult sharing their account with a younger family member, or an unusual pattern in browsing behavior, could prompt the AI to mistakenly flag an account. In such cases, users can appeal, but the process involves additional friction.

To reverse the restrictions, individuals must verify their age using an official ID, a selfie, or in some cases, a credit card. That requirement could feel intrusive for users who never agreed to be evaluated in the first place. Mistakenly flagged adults may find themselves locked out of the full Google experience until they complete a verification process that feels more aligned with border control than tech support.

Why Google Is Doing This

YouTube had already been piloting similar AI-based age detection tools earlier this year, and this expansion reflects mounting regulatory pressure. The UK enforces age checks for certain platforms, while U.S. states like Texas are pushing laws targeting age access for adult content. There’s no federal framework yet, but companies like Google are preemptively adapting to avoid future legal risk.

While the goal of protecting minors is broadly supported, the implementation highlights deeper trade-offs. Users may be uncomfortable with Google parsing their behavior to make deeply personal judgments without transparency. And the burden of proof shifts to the user, who must respond to a silent algorithmic verdict with sensitive documentation.

There’s a larger question here, too: Should any company have the power to decide your age based on vague behavioral cues, then quietly limit your access until you prove otherwise?

What do you think Google should be allowed to algorithmically decide your age? Drop your thoughts below.

  • How to Stop YouTube from Tracking Activity

keyPoints.title: Google's AI Age-Estimation System
keyPoints.explanation: Google is implementing a new AI system in the U.S. that estimates user ages based on behavior signals like search queries and viewing habits, replacing self-reported birthdates.

keyPoints.title: Effects of Being Flagged as a Minor
keyPoints.explanation: Accounts flagged as minors will enter 'teen mode,' reducing recommendations, disabling location history, restricting mature app downloads, and removing personalized ads.

keyPoints.title: Accuracy Concerns and Appeal Process
keyPoints.explanation: The AI system could mistakenly flag adults or misjudge ages, requiring users to verify identity through ID, selfies, or credit cards to restore full access, which can be intrusive.

keyPoints.title: Regulatory Motivation Behind the Change
keyPoints.explanation: Google’s AI age detection expansion responds to regulatory pressures in the UK and US, aiming to comply with laws requiring age checks for certain platforms and content.

keyPoints.title: Privacy and Ethical Concerns of Algorithmic Age Decisions
keyPoints.explanation: The approach raises questions about privacy, transparency, and the power of companies to determine your age based on behavioral data, potentially limiting access without clear human oversight.

title.rendered: You Can Now Generate AI Images on WhatsApp Using ChatGPT – Here’s How It Works

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • AI image generation now works inside WhatsApp ChatGPT, letting you create images from text prompts without using a separate app or site.
  • Free with daily limits based on your plan, allowing one image per day for non-Plus users, with expanded access for Plus and Pro users.
  • To use it, add ChatGPT as a WhatsApp contact, send your prompt, and the image is generated and delivered in the chat.
  • ChatGPT on WhatsApp isn’t just for images — it can also proofread text, help write emails, suggest recipes, and describe photos.
  • Be aware of possible account linking issues, especially for Plus and Pro users trying to connect their OpenAI subscription to WhatsApp.

OpenAI just gave ChatGPT users a big reason to open WhatsApp. You can now generate AI images directly within the ChatGPT chatbot on WhatsApp—no need to visit the website or use a separate app. Just send a text prompt, and you’ll receive a custom-generated image in return.

This rollout expands how users interact with ChatGPT on mobile. You can now engage with the bot using not only text but also voice messages and images. It brings the full force of generative AI tools into your everyday chat experience.

Image Generation on WhatsApp: Who Gets It and How It Works

According to OpenAI, this feature is available for free across all regions where ChatGPT is officially supported on WhatsApp. But there’s a small catch—if you don’t have a ChatGPT Plus account, you can only generate one image per day. After that, you’ll need to wait 24 hours to use it again.

ChatGPT Plus and Pro users can generate more images, but OpenAI admits that account linking is still rolling out. If you run into issues connecting your account, the best move is to sit tight and wait for future updates.

How to Generate Images with ChatGPT on WhatsApp

Here’s how you can try it right now:

  1. Open WhatsApp and tap the + button in the top right corner.
  2. Enter +1 (800) 242-8478 in the search bar, and ChatGPT will appear. Tap on it to access the ChatGPT chatbot.
  3. Send “Hi” to initiate the conversation, and ChatGPT will respond with an introductory message.

  4. Now, describe the image you want to generate, for example, “a cyberpunk street scene at night,” and hit the Send button.
  5. The AI responds with the generated image, which you can save and share.

It’s that easy—no app installs, no waiting time.

It’s More Than Just AI Images

ChatGPT on WhatsApp isn’t only about image creation. You can use it for a range of AI-powered tasks, including:

  • Writing and proofreading text
  • Drafting emails and social media captions
  • Suggesting recipes, summaries, and productivity tips
  • Describing uploaded images or providing visual context

This move transforms ChatGPT into a pocket productivity assistant inside one of the world’s most-used messaging platforms.

Read more: Codex vs Chatgpt Agent Use Cases

Why OpenAI’s WhatsApp Integration Matters

OpenAI’s entry into WhatsApp’s AI game follows Meta AI’s image generator and Perplexity AI’s chatbot launch. While those tools had a head start, OpenAI’s ChatGPT stands out due to its integration with DALL·E, multimodal understanding, and existing user loyalty.

For users already using ChatGPT on desktop or app, this brings a much-needed extension into their daily messaging experience.

The Future of ChatGPT on WhatsApp

This new capability points to OpenAI’s larger vision embedding powerful AI tools into natural, everyday communication. With WhatsApp as the medium, ChatGPT just got significantly more accessible to the average user.

Have you tried generating an image with ChatGPT on WhatsApp yet? Share your experience in the comments below.

If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure Dolby Atmos is turned on by heading to Settings > Apps > Music. Also, ensure you're using compatible headphones and that you're playing a track labeled with the Dolby Atmos badge.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're different. Dolby Atmos gives you a 3D surround effect, while Lossless delivers higher sound quality. If your device and headphones support both, you can use both together.

title.rendered: Apple Brings Live Video Shopping to India: How It Works

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple expands digital retail in India with ‘Shop with a Specialist over Video,’ its first international launch of the live shopping service outside the U.S.
  • One-way video calls simplify the experience by letting you speak with an Apple Specialist while only they appear on video, ensuring privacy and guidance.
  • Works on any internet-enabled device with no app download or sign-up needed—just visit Apple’s online store during business hours to start a session.
  • Service runs weekdays 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. IST, giving users live assistance in English through Apple’s website without appointment hassles.
  • Don’t share personal info during sessions since calls are live and not recorded; Apple advises keeping private data off-camera for added security.

Apple just rolled out its live video shopping feature in India, and honestly, I’m kind of surprised it took this long. The service, called Shop with a Specialist over Video, originally launched in the U.S. in 2023. Now India has become the first country outside the United States to get it.

How It Works

When you visit Apple’s official online store in India, there’s a new prompt that lets you tap in and talk to an Apple team member over a secure video call. It’s not a two-way call though. Only the Apple Specialist shows up on camera; you just use your mic to talk.

You can ask them anything. iPhone comparisons, trade-in values, EMI plans, how to choose between two models, whatever you’re stuck on. They’ll walk you through it while you browse the site in real time.

It works on any device with a solid internet connection, and the session runs in English. So, whether you’re using an iPad, Android phone, or even a crusty old PC, you’re good as long as your internet holds up.

Timing and Availability

Apple’s video shopping crew is live Monday through Friday, from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. IST. No app or special booking required. Just hit the site during those hours and you’ll see the option to connect.

Why Now, and Why India?

This one’s pretty telling. Apple’s clearly putting more chips on the table when it comes to India. They opened those flashy new stores in Mumbai and Delhi last year, and this move feels like a digital extension of that physical push.

It’s also Apple doing what Apple does best, trying to control the buying experience from start to finish. India’s retail setup is still super fragmented, so giving customers a direct line to trained Apple staff (even if just in English for now) helps tighten up their sales game.

Sure, it’s not the same as chatting with someone in person, but it’s a step toward blending that in-store vibe with the convenience of shopping from your couch. Whether they eventually expand it to other languages or time slots is anyone’s guess, but this feels like a pretty calculated first move.

Would real-time video help you settle on your next iPhone? Or maybe you’d prefer a quick chat instead of talking? Either way, drop your thoughts below.

  • How to choose which Apple Watch to buy in 2025
  • Which MacBook should you buy in 2025? Expert picks & tips!

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the App Store region affect any apps from the previous region?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing the App Store region doesn't directly affect apps from the previous region. You can still use the app if it's already downloaded on your device. However, due to regional restrictions, you might not be able to make new purchases within the app or use all its features.

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Tracked means the sound adjusts in real time based on how you move your head. So if you turn your head left, the audio stays anchored as if it's still coming from the same direction, creating a more realistic and immersive effect.

mainEntity.name: Is Dolby Atmos better than Lossless on Apple Music?

keyPoints.title: Apple's Live Video Shopping Launch in India
keyPoints.explanation: Apple introduced its 'Shop with a Specialist over Video' feature in India, making it the first country outside the U.S. to access this service, expanding its digital retail experience.

keyPoints.title: How the Video Shopping Feature Works
keyPoints.explanation: Customers visiting Apple's online store in India can initiate a secure video call with an Apple Specialist, who assists through a one-way video while users communicate via audio.

keyPoints.title: Device Compatibility and Session Details
keyPoints.explanation: The service works on any device with a stable internet connection, running in English, and does not require special apps or bookings—just visit the site during available hours.

keyPoints.title: Availability and Operating Hours of the Service
keyPoints.explanation: Apple's live video shopping is available Monday to Friday, from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. IST, providing a flexible and accessible customer support option in India.

keyPoints.title: Strategic Significance for Apple in India
keyPoints.explanation: This move reflects Apple's effort to strengthen its retail presence in India, offering a direct-to-consumer digital channel to complement its physical stores in Mumbai and Delhi.

title.rendered: iPhone 17 Price Hike Could Make All Models $50 More Expensive

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple may raise iPhone 17 prices by $50 to counter higher component costs and tariffs, affecting all models in the lineup this September.
  • All four iPhone 17 models could get pricier, including the new iPhone 17 Air, with starting prices moving closer to premium laptop territory.
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max may hit $1,299, a $50 bump that positions it squarely as a luxury-tier device in both price and expectation.
  • Carrier strength helps Apple absorb pricing risk, as strong U.S. sales trends suggest demand could hold despite higher up-front costs.
  • Price hike likely tied to new features, with Apple expected to lean on design tweaks or exclusive tech to justify the jump.

Apple could be planning a $50 price increase across the entire iPhone 17 lineup this fall, according to a new investor note from Jefferies analyst Edison Lee. The expected shift, timed with the series’ anticipated September debut, would reportedly help offset growing component expenses and continued U.S. tariffs on Chinese-made goods.

Every iPhone 17 Variant Targeted for Higher Pricing

The reported increase would impact all four iPhone 17 models: the standard iPhone 17, the newly introduced iPhone Air (which replaces the current Plus model), the iPhone 17 Pro, and the iPhone 17 Pro Max.

If Apple follows through, base pricing for the iPhone 17 family could shift as follows:

  • iPhone 17: from $799 to $849
  • iPhone 17 Air: from $899 to $949
  • iPhone 17 Pro: from $999 to $1,049
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max: from $1,199 to $1,249

That would bring the Pro Max dangerously close to the $1,300 threshold, nudging it further into laptop pricing territory.

Related: Apple’s India Manufacturing May Push iPhone 17 Prices Higher

Strong U.S. Carrier Sales Fuel Confidence

Despite the forecasted bump in price, Jefferies’ Lee kept a Hold rating on Apple stock, citing strong iPhone demand in Q2 2025. According to carrier data referenced in the note, U.S. telecoms saw a 22% year-over-year rise in equipment sales last quarter, the largest gain seen in a year and a half. Those numbers appear to have given Apple enough headroom to test higher pricing without major fallout.

How Apple Might Justify a Price Jump

Although the price adjustment seems likely, Apple may avoid framing it as a direct response to tariffs. A May report from The Wall Street Journal also indicated that Apple was evaluating a price hike for the iPhone 17 series, with plans to introduce new design elements and features to justify the added cost. Whether those updates will feel meaningful to buyers remains to be seen.

Impact for Buyers: Trade-In or Pay Up

If the $50 hike materializes, most buyers will likely feel the squeeze, especially those eyeing the Pro models. Carrier deals and trade-in offers could soften the blow, but out-of-pocket costs are still headed north.

Would a $50 increase make you rethink your upgrade plans? Let us know where you stand in the comments.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Leak Shows Bold New Orange Color Option
  • iPhone 17 Pro Leak Reveals 8x Zoom and Pro Camera App
  • iPhone 17 Air Could Come With a Surprisingly Small Battery

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

title.rendered: How to change your Instagram password (Even if you forgot it)

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Logged in and ready to switch: If you’re already signed into Instagram on your iPhone and know your current password, just head to Settings > Accounts Center to change it. Simple enough.
  • Desktop version’s slightly different: On a browser, log in, click your profile, go to Settings, then Password and Security, and follow the steps. No surprises there.
  • Forgot your password on iPhone?: Tap “Forgot Password?” on the login screen. Enter your username, email, or phone number, then follow the reset link. Works fast, as long as your info’s current.
  • Lost access via desktop: Hit “Forgot Password?” on Instagram’s website, pop in your username or email, then check your inbox for the reset link. You’re back in once you set a new one.
  • Make your password count: Pick something long and unique with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols. Using a password manager helps—trust me, it saves headaches later.

Have you forgotten your Instagram password, or are you afraid someone hacked your account? Don’t worry—you’re not alone! Whether you’re simply looking to update your password or you’ve found yourself locked out, we’ve got you covered.

This guide will show you how to change or reset your Instagram password on your iPhone or desktop, allowing you to regain control of your account and start using Instagram again.

Table of Contents
  • How to change your Instagram password on iPhone
  • How to change your Instagram password on desktop
  • How to reset your Instagram password if you forgot it
    • On iPhone
    • On Desktop

How to change your Instagram password on iPhone

Changing your Instagram password on an iPhone is simple. This method is for users who are already logged in to their Instagram account and remember their current password.

If you don’t remember the credentials and can’t access your account, you may jump to the reset password section below. Let’s see how to update Instagram password:

  1. Open the Instagram app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap on your profile picture in the bottom-right corner.
  3. Tap the More button (with three horizontal lines) in the top-right corner, then select Accounts Center.
  4. Scroll down and tap on Password and Security.

  5. Now select the Change Password option and choose your Instagram account.
  6. Enter your current password, then type in your desired password twice.
  7. Ensure the Log Out of Other Devices box is checked.
  8. Tap Change Password to update your Instagram password.

You must use a combination of at least six numbers, letters, special characters (!$@%), etc. in your password The iCloud Keychain or a third-party password manager on your iPhone is a nice way to generate a strong password.

Note If you can access your Instagram account but don’t remember the login password, tap on Forgot your Password? in the fifth step and follow the on-screen instructions.

How to change your Instagram password on desktop

If you prefer using your desktop, you can also change your Instagram password on the web.

  1. Go to Instagram in your preferred web browser and log in to your account.
  2. Click on More in the bottom-left corner of the window and select Settings.

  3. Click See More in Accounts Center.

  4. Select Password and Security from the left panel and click Change Password under Login & Recovery in the right pane.

  5. Select your Instagram account.

  6. Enter your current password, then type in your new desired password twice.
  7. Finally, click Change Password to change your Instagram password.

How to reset your Instagram password if you forgot it

Are you trying to log in to your Instagram account but can’t remember the correct password? Forgetting your Instagram password is common, but thankfully, resetting it is easy. Here’s what you need to do.

On iPhone

  1. Launch the Instagram app and select the account for which you want to reset the password.
  2. Tap Forgot Password? on the login page.
  3. Enter your username or email address. You can also search your account using the associated mobile number.
  4. Tap on Continue.

  5. Select Try Another Way.
  6. Select a verification method. I chose Get Code or Link via Email. You can see the associated email address underneath. If you don’t recognize it, tap No Longer Have Access to These?
  7. Next, tap on Continue. Instagram will send you a link to reset your password.

  8. Open the received email and click the Reset Your Password button. Check your Spam folder if you can’t find the email.
  9. Enter your new password twice and hit Reset Password.

If you’ve enabled two-factor authentication for your account, you must enter the six-digit code sent to your linked phone number. Now, you can log in to your account using the new password.

You can also confirm your identity using your selfie to recover your Instagram account. Tap on Can’t Reset Your Password? in step three.

Select the Yes, Take a Selfie to Confirm My Account option and tap Next. Enter any password you have used for this account previously and tap Next. Select email or your phone number to receive a code and tap Next. Enter the six-digit code and follow the on-screen instructions.

On Desktop

  1. Open your web browser and log in to Instagram.
  2. Click Forgot Password? on the login page.

  3. Enter your username, email address, or phone number associated with your account.
  4. Next, click Send Login Link.

  5. Instagram will send you a link to reset your password. Follow the instructions in the email to set a new password.

Signing off…

I hope now you can change or reset your Instagram password easily, ensuring your account remains secure and accessible. Make sure to choose a strong password and update it regularly. If you still can’t regain your account, contact the Instagram help center.

FAQs

Can you change your Instagram password through Facebook?

Yes, if your Instagram account is linked to your Facebook account, you can change your Instagram password through Facebook. Go to Instagram’s login page, select Log in with Facebook, and then follow the prompts to change your password.

Why am I not getting a password reset email from Instagram?

If you’re not receiving the password reset email, check your Spam folder. Make sure you’re using the correct email address associated with your Instagram account. If the problem persists, contact Instagram support.

What to do if the Instagram password reset link is not working?

If the reset link is not working, it could be that you’re using an old link. Ensure you’re using the latest link sent to your email, as sometimes, older links can expire. If you’re still having trouble, request a new password reset link from Instagram, by repeating the steps shown in the guide above.

  • How to unlink your Facebook account from Instagram: A quick guide
  • How to view Instagram stories anonymously
  • How to save Instagram posts and reels as drafts on iPhone
  • How to remove a remembered account on Instagram

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change country in the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple's stringent requirements make changing your App Store country harder to ensure a smooth transition and adherence to regional regulations. Each nation has its laws concerning digital media and applications. So, you must meet all the criteria to be able to continue purchasing items from your new country's App Store. Also, Apple doesn't want one to lose credit balance, subscriptions, pre-orders etc. This means that if even one condition is not satisfied, you can't complete the process. To learn more about this, go through what to do before changing your App Store Country or region.

mainEntity.name: How to change App Store country without a credit card?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing your App Store country without a credit card is possible. When entering payment details, select 'None' as the payment method. This allows you to make the switch without entering a new card. However, you won't be able to make any purchases until you add a valid payment method. If you don't see the None option, maybe you have an unpaid balance or due payments. Also, recurring subscription mandates and Family Sharing prevent you from changing the App Store without a credit card. In such a case, you need to create a new Apple ID in that region.

mainEntity.name: How many times can I change my App Store country?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a clear answer to how many times you can change your App Store country. However, to avoid issues, you should only change the App Store location when you really need to. Creating a new Apple ID with a new billing address can be a significantly better option if you need to change your App Store location frequently.

keyPoints.title: Changing Instagram Password on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: If you're already logged in and remember your current password, you can change it through the Accounts Center in the app settings on your iPhone.

keyPoints.title: Changing Instagram Password on Desktop
keyPoints.explanation: On a desktop, log into your Instagram account via a web browser, navigate to Settings, then to Password and Security, and follow the prompts to update your password.

keyPoints.title: Resetting Your Instagram Password if Forgotten (iPhone)
keyPoints.explanation: Access the Instagram app, tap 'Forgot Password?', enter your details, and follow the instructions sent to your email or phone to reset your password.

keyPoints.title: Resetting Your Instagram Password if Forgotten (Desktop)
keyPoints.explanation: Visit the Instagram login page, click 'Forgot Password?', enter your username or email, and follow the link sent to your email to create a new password.

keyPoints.title: Tips for Securing Your Instagram Account
keyPoints.explanation: Use a strong, unique password combining numbers, letters, and symbols, and consider using a password manager to create and store your passwords securely.
