title.rendered: How to download and use Spotify on Mac?

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Install Spotify on Mac via the official site by downloading the installer, unzipping it, and moving the app to your Applications folder.
  • Free users can now download playlists offline directly in the desktop app—no Premium subscription needed for offline listening.
  • Group Sessions let you share playback in real-time—tap Devices Available and invite friends to sync listening, even across different locations.
  • Stop Spotify from launching at login by toggling off auto-start in the app’s settings under the Startup and Window Behavior section.
  • You can tweak audio with the built-in equalizer and change stream quality settings to match your sound preferences or connection type.

If you’re a music lover, you’ve probably heard of Spotify. It is a digital music service that gives you access to millions of songs, podcasts, and videos from artists worldwide. However, you might have only used Spotify on your iPhone all these times. If you are wondering how to download and use Spotify on Mac, this article should suffice.

Table of Contents
  • How to download Spotify on Mac
  • Tips for using Spotify on Mac
    • 1. Download songs on Spotify Mac app
    • 2. Use Group Session on Spotify
    • 3. Prevent opening Spotify on Mac startup
    • 4. Access equalizer
    • 5. Adjust music quality
    • 6. Change the external speaker

How to download Spotify on Mac

  1. Visit the following link to download the installer for Spotify on Mac.
  2. Hit the Download button.

  3. After downloading, visit the folder, and unzip the Spotify installer.
  4. Double-click on the installation file and complete the installation process.

Note: You can also access Spotify and listen to music through the browser. Just enter your credentials and you’re good to go.

Tips for using Spotify on Mac

Now let us look at some of the things you can do with the Spotify app. Please note that most of the features mentioned here work with the Mac app, not the web app. However, I will mention if there are any features available for the web app.

1. Download songs on Spotify Mac app

While you can’t download Spotify songs and albums directly, you can instead download the playlists. Just open the playlist and hit the download button. This feature is available even for the free version!

2. Use Group Session on Spotify

While playing a song, tap the Devices Available icon → Start Session. You can send links or scans to your friends and enjoy music together.

3. Prevent opening Spotify on Mac startup

Annoyed with Spotify opening by default? Read our guide to stop apps from opening at startup on Mac.

4. Access equalizer

Go to Spotify Settings (⌘ + ,) → Scroll down till Playback to see the equalizer. Make sure to toggle on Equilizer to use the feature.

5. Adjust music quality

Even in the free version of Spotify for Mac, you can adjust the audio quality. Visit the preferences page, and you can adjust the audio quality under Audio quality.

6. Change the external speaker

You can change the output from your Mac speaker to other. All you have to do is, click the devices icon and select the output of your choice.

Hear music whenever you want!

After installing Spotify on your Mac, you can hear songs, podcasts, or anything you want. If you still have any doubts or queries, please drop them in the comments.

FAQs

Why can’t I download Spotify on my iMac? 

First, ensure your internet connection is fast and stable. Also, make sure there is space to download the application. You can also try installing the web app since it won’t take up that much space.

How do I get Spotify on my older Mac? 

You can check the official webpage to see if the app is available for your Mac. If it’s not supported, you can still get the web app if Chrome or the browser can still run on your Mac.

  • DaVinci Resolve for iPad: A detailed guide to use key features
  • How to recover deleted files from emptied trash on Mac
  • 7 Spotify Gestures Every User Should Know!

keyPoints.title: Offline Listening for Free Users
keyPoints.explanation: You can download playlists for offline listening directly through the desktop app, even if you have a free Spotify account.

keyPoints.title: Sharing Music with Group Sessions
keyPoints.explanation: Start a Group Session by selecting the Devices Available icon, allowing friends in different locations to listen together.

keyPoints.title: Controlling Startup Behavior
keyPoints.explanation: Disable Spotify from opening automatically at login through the app’s settings to prevent it from launching on startup.

keyPoints.title: Customizing Audio Settings
keyPoints.explanation: Adjust the equalizer and music quality in the app’s preferences to personalize your listening experience.

title.rendered: How to drag and drop files and text between apps on iPhone

content.rendered:
With the iOS 15 update, Apple makes multitasking even smoother. The update enables you to quickly drag and drop text, files, and images between apps on your iPhone. And the best part? It is super simple to use.

Let me show you how!

How to move items with drag and drop on iPhone 

  1. Open the source app you want to copy from.
  2. Select the text/photos/files you want to move.
  3. Long-press the selected content and slightly drag it upwards.
    It’ll appear as a floating box.
  4. Without lifting the current finger, use the second finger to bring the app switcher or Home Screen and tap the destination app.

  5. The floating box will hover over the new app. Drop it there.

Note:

  • You’ll observe a + icon at the top right of the content you are moving across apps; this means the app supports the drop.
  • In the destination app, if you want to take some actions like open a new note or compose a new mail before dropping the content, follow the usual steps. Don’t remove your finger from the floating box.

Which apps/content support drag and drop?

I have been experimenting with the feature quite a bit and am happy to report that it supports

  • Text and URLs
  • Photos and videos  
  • Audio files, documents, PDF, and more

I even went on to test some apps that support the feature. And I am glad to say that the feature worked on all:

  • Note-taking apps
  • Email apps (Gmail, Spark)
  • Messaging apps (iMessage, Telegram, WhatsApp)

Surprisingly, while Instagram supported the feature, Twitter did not. Hopefully, the subsequent updates will rectify that.

Despite being in the beta version, it worked like a charm. And trust me, once you get the hang of it, you won’t be able to look back.

It has definitely become one of the handiest hidden features of iOS 15. What about you? Which iOS 15 feature are you looking forward to most? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

keyPoints.title: Initiate Dragging Content
keyPoints.explanation: Tap and hold on content like text or images until it lifts from the screen, preparing for drag-and-drop.

keyPoints.title: Gather Multiple Items
keyPoints.explanation: While still holding the first item, use another finger to tap additional files or photos to create a stack for moving.

keyPoints.title: Switch Apps During Drag
keyPoints.explanation: With the content still held, swipe up to enter the Home Screen or App Switcher and open a different app to drop the items.

keyPoints.title: Drop Items in Destination App
keyPoints.explanation: Once in the target app, release your finger over the desired location to drop the content, completing the transfer.

keyPoints.title: Supported Content and Apps
keyPoints.explanation: iOS 15 supports dragging text, URLs, photos, videos, audio files, documents, and works across various apps like note-taking, email, and messaging apps.

title.rendered: How to Use HomePod as an Intercom: A Complete Guide

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Turn on Intercom in the Home app to start sending voice messages across HomePods and other Apple devices in your home network.
  • Use Siri to broadcast messages to all rooms or specific HomePods—perfect for sharing reminders or announcements hands-free.
  • Intercom supports a wide range of Apple devices including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods, CarPlay, and both HomePod models.
  • You can reply directly to Intercom messages and your response will go back to the original sender or target a specific room.
  • Customize Intercom alerts per device so you only get voice messages where and when you want—like only on AirPods or while driving.

The HomePod smart speaker can add a lot of value to your life, from playing ambient sounds to creating sleep playlists. At its October 2020 event, Apple unveiled the HomePod Mini and a new feature called intercom that will also be available on the older HomePod. This lets you communicate with the different areas of your home through Siri’s voice commands.

For instance, you can let everyone know that dinner is ready or remind your child to go to bed, etc. Let’s dig deeper and learn how to use Intercom on HomePods.

Note: Currently, the intercom feature only works if you have more than one HomePod/HomePod Mini speaker.  Also, you must be using the latest version of iOS 14.2 or iPadOS 14.2, and your HomePod speakers must be updated with the latest software.

  • How to Turn ON Intercom on HomePods
  • How to Use Intercom on HomePod
    • Send an Intercom Message
    • Reply to an Intercom Message
  • Use Intercom with AirPods, Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad

How to Turn ON Intercom on HomePods

  1. Open the Home app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Tap and hold the HomePod tile, then select Settings.
  3. Select Intercom.
  4. Toggle ON for each HomePod speaker.

If you wish to disable the intercom feature just turn off the switch next to each HomePod speaker.

How to Use Intercom on HomePod

To Send an Intercom Message

You can send messages to all the HomePod speakers in your home or choose a specific zone or room to relay it to. It’s super simple to do using Hey Siri. 

For example, you can say:

“Hey Siri, intercom, dinner is ready.”

Or,

“Hey Siri, ask everyone, ready to leave?”

To send a message to a specific room, say something like:

“Hey Siri, announce to the kitchen, I’m caught up with homework. I’ll eat later..”

Or,

“Hey Siri, ask downstairs, what movie are we watching tonight?'”

To Reply to an Intercom Message

Once you hear an intercom message on a HomePod, you can reply back in a similar way using “Hey Siri,” too. If the message was just for the zone/room you’re in, your response will only be relayed to the sender speaker. Similarly, If the message was for the whole home, the reply will be sent to all the speakers.

To reply, say something like:

“Hey Siri, reply, coming down in five.”

“Hey Siri, reply just grabbing my jacket.'”

However, you can also choose to send your reply only to specific HomePod speakers by simply instructing Siri. For instance:

“Hey Siri, reply upstairs, we’re watching the latest Netflix release.”

“Hey Siri, reply to the living room ‘I’m not in the mood for a movie today. I’m going to bed.'”

Use Intercom with AirPods, Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad

What makes the intercom feature even better is that you’ll be able to send messages to HomePods from your Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, and even CarPlay. You’ll also be able to receive messages on AirPods, which creates a seamless ecosystem.

Of course, you’ll also be able to select which devices Intercom messages are delivered to and when intercom notifications are sent to your device. So, for example, you will be able to turn off Intercom notifications on your iPhone when you’re busy at work.

These handy features are expected to become available soon as shared by Apple Event.

Signing off

We hope this has helped you learn how to use HomePod as an intercom to add convenience to your life. What are your thoughts about this feature? Share with us in the comments below.

  • How to Use Handoff with HomePod Mini and HomePod

@graph.name: How to Set up Intercom on HomePod
@graph.description: Learn how to set up the Intercom feature on your HomePod so you can send voice messages to other HomePods in your home.

supply.name: iPhone or iPad with Home app

step.name: Open the Home app
step.text: Launch the Home app on your iPhone or iPad to access your HomePod settings.

itemListElement.text: Locate and open the Home app on your device.

step.name: Access HomePod settings
step.text: Tap and hold the HomePod tile, then select Settings to open its configuration options.

itemListElement.text: Find your HomePod in the Home app.
Tap and hold its tile.
Select Settings from the options.

step.name: Turn on Intercom
step.text: Select the Intercom option and toggle it ON for each HomePod speaker you want to use.

itemListElement.text: Select Intercom from the settings menu.
Toggle ON the switch for each HomePod speaker.

keyPoints.title: Enable Intercom on HomePods
keyPoints.explanation: Activate the intercom feature through the Home app on your iPhone or iPad, allowing you to manage settings for each speaker.

keyPoints.title: Send Voice Announcements Using Siri
keyPoints.explanation: Use Siri on any Apple device to send messages to all or specific rooms within your home, ideal for reminders or updates.

keyPoints.title: Device Compatibility for Intercom
keyPoints.explanation: Intercom works seamlessly with HomePod, HomePod mini, iPhones, iPads, Apple Watches, AirPods, and CarPlay, creating a versatile communication system.

keyPoints.title: Reply to Intercom Messages
keyPoints.explanation: You can directly reply to received intercom messages, and your response will be sent back to the original sender or specific speakers.

keyPoints.title: Using Intercom Across Apple Devices
keyPoints.explanation: Send and receive intercom messages on AirPods, Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, and CarPlay, with customizable notification settings for convenience.

title.rendered: How to find the serial number of your iPhone even if it is lost

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Find your iPhone’s serial number in Settings by going to General > About—you can copy it directly for support or warranty use.
  • Check the barcode on your iPhone box for a printed serial number, helpful if your device won’t power on or is lost.
  • Log into the Apple ID site to view serials remotely—select your device under the Devices section to find its details.
  • Serial numbers are listed on receipts and AppleCare docs so check purchase confirmations or upgrade program paperwork if the box is gone.
  • Other Apple devices and backups can reveal it—look in Settings on linked devices or in Finder/iTunes backups on a Mac.

Knowing how to locate your device’s serial number is essential if you’re trying to check warranty information, troubleshoot a technical issue, or simply register your device. In this guide, I’ll walk you through several methods to find the serial number of your iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • What does Apple product serial number mean?
    • Importance of iPhone serial number
  • 9 Ways to find your iPhone serial number
    • 1. Use the Settings app on iPhone
    • 2. View the serial number via the Apple website
    • 3. View the serial number on iPhone's buying box
    • 4. In purchase email
    • 5. With AppleCare+ or iPhone upgrade program receipt
    • 6. On your other Apple device
    • 7. Check serial number by Computer backup
    • 8. Check serial number by recovery mode
    • 9. Check the serial number engraved on the device

What does Apple product serial number mean?

Apple assigns a unique alphanumeric code known as the serial number to each iPhone or iPad it assembles. This code serves as a unique identifier and can be found in various locations on the device.

Knowing the serial number has several advantages, including tracking warranty information, reporting lost or stolen devices, and facilitating repair or replacement requests. However, understanding the significance of this code is necessary before attempting to access it.

Importance of iPhone serial number

The serial number on an iPhone is critical information that can be used in a variety of situations. Here are some of the reasons why the serial number is significant:

  • If your iPhone requires repair or replacement, you must provide the serial number to Apple or an authorized service provider.
  • The serial number also activates the iPhone’s Activation Lock feature.
  • If you sell or transfer ownership of your device, the new owner may require the serial number to verify its authenticity.
  • When you contact Apple support for help with your iPhone, the representative may request the serial number to confirm the device’s eligibility for support.

Now that you understand the significance of the serial number, let’s explore how to locate it on your iPhone.

9 Ways to find your iPhone serial number

Finding your iPhone’s serial number is easy. Just follow the methods outlined below!

1. Use the Settings app on iPhone

  1. Launch the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap General → About.
  3. Next to the Serial Number is your device’s unique code.

Additionally, you can tap and hold the unique serial number to copy it.

2. View the serial number via the Apple website

The steps below are performed on an iPhone. However, as the steps are particularly similar, you can also access the Apple website using a Mac or PC.

  1. Open any browser. I’m using Chrome browser.
  2. Head to the Apple ID website.
  3. Select Sign In.
  4. Enter your Apple ID and passcode to log in.
  5. Tap the down arrow next to Apple ID.
  6. Choose Devices from the dropdown list.

  7. Now, select your iPhone to check its serial number.

3. View the serial number on iPhone’s buying box

Looking up the unique code on your iPhone’s original box is a simple method to check for its serial number. The back of the box has an engraving of the device’s serial number, which you can use to verify its authenticity or access Apple’s various support and warranty services.

4. In purchase email

If you bought your iPhone or iPad online, you may be able to find the serial number in the purchase email itself.

  1. Launch the Mail app.
  2. Look for the purchase email you received when you purchased your iPhone or iPad.
  3. Open the receipt in that email.
  4. Look for the serial number under the purchase information section.

5. With AppleCare+ or iPhone upgrade program receipt

If you have AppleCare+ or are using the iPhone Upgrade Program, you can find the serial number of your iPhone or iPad on the receipt or confirmation email.

6. On your other Apple device

To check the serial number of a particular Apple device, you can also use another Apple device that is associated with the same Apple ID. Simply follow the steps provided below to do so.

Here, I have used another iPhone.

  1. Head to Settings.
  2. Tap on your name icon.
  3. Scroll down and select your device.

Now, next to the Serial Number, you can verify the distinctive serial number assigned to your device.

7. Check serial number by Computer backup

You can verify your iPhone or iPad’s serial number if you’ve previously backed it up on the same Mac. Simply connect your device to your Mac and follow the instructions provided below.

  1. Open Finder.
  2. Locate your iPhone or iPad under Locations.
  3. Select Manage Backups beneath Backups in the General tab.

  4. Select the device name under Devices.
  5. Hover over the device name.
  6. You can now see the serial number with other details in the grey box.

8. Check serial number by recovery mode

If you want to check your iPhone’s serial number, you can use a USB-C to Lightning cable to connect your device to a Mac and enable recovery mode. This will reveal a unique code for your device, which will be displayed alongside the Serial label located below the device name.

9. Check the serial number engraved on the device

Although newer iPhones lack this feature, if you have an iPhone 4S or an older model, you can find the serial number on the SIM tray. The serial number is also engraved on the back of the original iPhone.

Concluding…

Knowing your device’s serial number is useful for troubleshooting and repairs, as well as for important tasks such as warranty registration and insurance claims. By locating your device’s serial number, you can ensure you have all the required information to maintain and protect your iPhone or iPad.

FAQs

How do you check if an iPhone is original?

To check if an iPhone is original, you can look at the packaging, check the physical appearance, check the software, check the IMEI number, and use Apple’s Support app.

How to find the UDID number on iPhone?

Locating the UDID number on your iPhone is a simple task, but if you run into any problems, I recommend reading our article on how to find the UDID of an iPhone or iPad for a comprehensive guide.

Are UDID and serial number similar on iPhone?

UDID and serial number are two distinct things. The UDID is a unique 40-character alphanumeric code used by developers to identify an individual iPhone or iPad. The serial number, on the other hand, is a distinct string of numbers and letters that identifies a specific iPhone model.

  • How to find an iPhone that’s lost or stolen
  • What iPhone model do I have? Find your iPhone model
  • What Is an EID Number? How to Find Your EID on an iPhone

mainEntity.name: How do you check if an iPhone is original?

acceptedAnswer.text: To check if an iPhone is original, you can look at the packaging, check the physical appearance, check the software, check the IMEI number, and use Apple's Support app.

mainEntity.name: How to find the UDID number on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Locating the UDID number on your iPhone is a simple task, but if you run into any problems, I recommend reading our article on how to find the UDID of an iPhone or iPad for a comprehensive guide.

mainEntity.name: Are UDID and serial number similar on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: UDID and serial number are two distinct things. The UDID is a unique 40-character alphanumeric code used by developers to identify an individual iPhone or iPad. The serial number, on the other hand, is a distinct string of numbers and letters that identifies a specific iPhone model.

@graph.name: How to find your iPhone serial number using Settings app
@graph.description: Easily locate your iPhone’s unique serial number through the Settings app in just a few taps.

step.name: Open Settings
step.text: Launch the Settings app on your iPhone to begin.

itemListElement.text: Find and tap the Settings app icon on your Home Screen.

step.name: Go to About section
step.text: Tap General, then select About to see your iPhone’s detailed information.

itemListElement.text: In Settings, tap General.
Select About from the menu.

step.name: Find the serial number
step.text: Look for the Serial Number field — your unique device code will be displayed next to it.

itemListElement.text: Scroll to locate the Serial Number field.
Note down the code for reference or support purposes.

@graph.name: How to find your iPhone serial number via Apple website
@graph.description: Easily locate your iPhone’s serial number by signing in to your Apple ID account on the Apple website.

step.name: Open a browser and go to Apple ID website
step.text: Launch your preferred browser and head to the official Apple ID website.

itemListElement.text: Open Chrome, Safari, or any other browser.
Visit the Apple ID website.

step.name: Sign in to your Apple ID
step.text: Select Sign In, then enter your Apple ID and password to log in securely.

itemListElement.text: Click the Sign In option.
Enter your Apple ID email and password.
Complete two-factor authentication if prompted.

step.name: Access your devices list
step.text: Tap the down arrow next to Apple ID and choose Devices from the dropdown list.

itemListElement.text: Click the down arrow beside your Apple ID.
Select Devices from the menu.

step.name: Find your iPhone’s serial number
step.text: Select your iPhone from the devices list to view its serial number.

itemListElement.text: Locate your iPhone in the list.
Click on it to reveal the serial number.

keyPoints.title: Locate your serial number in Settings
keyPoints.explanation: Open Settings > General > About on your iPhone to find the serial number easily; you can also copy it for further use.

keyPoints.title: Check the serial number on original packaging
keyPoints.explanation: The serial number is printed on the barcode label of your iPhone's original box, providing a quick verification method.

keyPoints.title: View serial number on the Apple website
keyPoints.explanation: Sign into the Apple ID website, select Devices, and choose your device to view its serial number remotely.

keyPoints.title: Find serial number on purchase documents or receipts
keyPoints.explanation: Your serial number can be checked on purchase emails or receipts from AppleCare+ or iPhone upgrade programs.

keyPoints.title: Use other Apple devices or backups to find the serial number
keyPoints.explanation: Check on other linked Apple devices via Settings or review your device backups on your Mac to find the serial number.

title.rendered: How to shut down and restart Apple Vision Pro

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Standard Shutdown: You can shut down the Vision Pro by pressing and holding the top button and the Digital Crown simultaneously, then swiping the power off slider.
  • Settings Shutdown: Alternatively, you can go to Settings > General > Shut Down and drag the slider to power off the device.
  • Siri Command: A simple way to shut down is to use a voice command: “Siri, turn off my Apple Vision Pro.”
  • Automatic Shutdown: The Vision Pro will automatically shut down after 24 hours of inactivity to conserve battery life.
  • Restarting: To restart, press and hold the top button until the Apple logo appears. If the battery was disconnected, simply reconnecting it will turn the device on.
  • Force Restart: If the Vision Pro is unresponsive, you can force a restart by holding the top button and the Digital Crown together until the Apple logo reappears.
  • Disconnecting the Battery: As a last resort, if other methods fail, you can disconnect the power cable from the Audio Strap to turn off the device.

Are you disconnecting your Apple Vision Pro away from the power every time you want to turn it off? Let me save you the trouble and show you how to shut down and restart your Apple Vision Pro systematically.

Whether you are experiencing technical issues or simply need to perform a routine maintenance check, restarting will help you out. So, let’s learn all the necessary procedures to ensure a smooth shutdown and restart of your Apple Vision Pro.

How to shut down Apple Vision Pro?

When your Apple Vision Pro is connected to the battery and turned on, it goes into sleep mode when you take it off. After that, whenever you wear it again, it automatically turns on. You don’t have to power off your Vision Pro every time it’s not in use.

However, if you’re specifically looking to turn off the Apple Vision Pro, it is a very simple process. You can carry out this idea in three different ways.

Method 1: Using button controls

  1. Press and hold the Digital Crown and top button together until the Power Off slider appears.

  2. Now, look at the Power Off slider and swipe it to the right by performing a pinch gesture.

Method 2: Via Settings

You may systematically shut down your Apple Vision Pro through the Settings menu.

  1. Go to the Home view → Open Settings.

  2. Select General menu → Click Shut Down.
  3. Now look at the Power Off slider and drag it to the right doing a pinch gesture.

Method 3: Command Siri

The easiest way to perform a shutdown is to invoke Siri and ask it to power off your Apple Vision Pro. However, you must have Siri enabled.

If you have not already set up Siri on your Apple Vision Pro, open Home view and navigate to Settings → Click Siri & Search on the left pane → Toggle on Listen for “Hey Siri” or “Siri.” 

I hope you have successfully turned off your Vision Pro. If none of the above-mentioned methods work, simply disconnect your Apple Vision Pro from the battery. It will eventually run out of juice and shut down after 24 hours of inactivity.

How to turn on Apple Vision Pro?

Once you’ve switched off the Apple Vision Pro, here are the possible ways to get it back up again:

  •  Press and hold the top button on your Apple Vision Pro for a few seconds. As an Apple logo appears on the screen, let the buttons go. Your Vision Pro will turn on in a bit.
  • If you end up disconnecting your Apple Vision Pro from the power, put it back to charge. Wait for a while until it has enough battery to respond. Your Vision Pro will turn on automatically.

How to force restart Apple Vision Pro?

Unfortunately, if your Apple Vision Pro is not responding, the easiest way to rectify this issue is to perform a force restart.

  1. Keep holding the top button and Digital Crown until the screen goes black.
  2. Continue holding the buttons as the Force Quit Applications and Power Off slider appear on the screen.
  3. Once the Apple logo prompts your screen, take off your fingers.

FAQs

Can I schedule automatic restarts for my Apple Vision Pro?

As of the latest information available, Apple Vision Pro does not have a built-in feature to schedule automatic restarts.

How long does it take for the Apple Vision Pro to restart?

The restart time may vary, but typically, it should take a minute or two for the Apple Vision Pro to fully restart and become operational.

Shut down Apple Vision like a Pro!

In conclusion, shutting down and restarting the Apple Vision Pro is a simple process that can be done in a few steps. While you’re at it, take some time to save the data of your currently active apps to avoid losing any important data.

Thank you for reading. If you have any doubts, do not hesitate to leave your thoughts in the comment section below.

@graph.name: How to shut down Apple Vision Pro using button controls
@graph.description: Learn how to power off your Apple Vision Pro using the Digital Crown and top button with simple on-device controls.

step.name: Press and hold both buttons
step.text: Press and hold the Digital Crown and top button together until the Power Off slider appears on the display.

itemListElement.text: Locate the Digital Crown on one side of your Apple Vision Pro.
Find the top button positioned above the Digital Crown.
Press and hold both buttons at the same time until the Power Off slider appears.

step.name: Use the Power Off slider
step.text: Look at the Power Off slider and swipe it to the right by performing a pinch gesture to turn off the device.

itemListElement.text: Focus your gaze on the Power Off slider.
Perform a pinch gesture and swipe the slider to the right.
Wait for the device to shut down completely.

@graph.name: How to shut down Apple Vision Pro via Settings
@graph.description: Follow these simple steps to turn off your Apple Vision Pro using the Settings menu instead of hardware buttons.

step.name: Open Settings
step.text: From the Home view on your Apple Vision Pro, open the Settings app to access device options.

itemListElement.text: Navigate to the Home view.
Locate and select the Settings app.

step.name: Go to the General menu
step.text: In the Settings app, scroll and select the General menu to find shutdown options.

itemListElement.text: Scroll through the Settings menu.
Tap the General option.

step.name: Shut down the device
step.text: Select the Shut Down option, then look at the Power Off slider and swipe it to the right using a pinch gesture.

itemListElement.text: Select Shut Down from the General menu.
Look at the Power Off slider.
Perform a pinch gesture and drag the slider to the right.

@graph.name: How to shut down Apple Vision Pro via Siri Command
@graph.description: Turn off your Apple Vision Pro hands-free by using Siri voice commands. This guide walks you through enabling Siri and issuing the shutdown command.

step.name: Enable Siri on Apple Vision Pro
step.text: If Siri is not already set up, open the Home view, go to Settings, click Siri & Search, and toggle on Listen for 'Hey Siri' or 'Siri'.

itemListElement.text: From the Home view, open the Settings app.
Select Siri & Search from the left pane.
Toggle on Listen for 'Hey Siri' or 'Siri'.

step.name: Give the shutdown command
step.text: Say 'Hey Siri, shut down Apple Vision Pro' to initiate the power-off sequence.

itemListElement.text: Activate Siri using 'Hey Siri' or by pressing and holding the Digital Crown.
Say the command: 'Shut down Apple Vision Pro'.
Confirm shutdown if prompted.

@graph.name: How to turn on Apple Vision Pro
@graph.description: Learn how to power on your Apple Vision Pro using the top button or by connecting it to power if the battery is drained.

step.name: Turn on using the top button
step.text: Press and hold the top button on your Apple Vision Pro for a few seconds until the Apple logo appears, then release the button. Your device will power on shortly.

itemListElement.text: Locate the top button on your Apple Vision Pro.
Press and hold the top button for a few seconds.
Release the button when the Apple logo appears.
Wait for the device to complete startup.

step.name: Turn on after charging
step.text: If your Apple Vision Pro battery is completely drained, connect it to the charger and wait until it has enough battery to start. The device will turn on automatically.

itemListElement.text: Connect your Apple Vision Pro to the charging cable and power adapter.
Wait a few minutes to allow the battery to charge.
The device will power on automatically when it has enough battery.

@graph.name: How to force restart Apple Vision Pro
@graph.description: Learn how to force restart your Apple Vision Pro by using the top button and Digital Crown to resolve unresponsive issues.

step.name: Press and hold both buttons
step.text: Keep holding the top button and Digital Crown at the same time until the screen goes black.

itemListElement.text: Locate the top button and Digital Crown on your Apple Vision Pro.
Press and hold both buttons simultaneously.
Keep holding until the screen goes completely black.

step.name: Continue holding through prompts
step.text: Continue holding the buttons even when the Force Quit Applications and Power Off slider appear on the screen.

itemListElement.text: Ignore the Force Quit Applications prompt.
Ignore the Power Off slider.
Keep holding the buttons past these prompts.

step.name: Release when Apple logo appears
step.text: Once the Apple logo appears on your screen, release both buttons to complete the force restart.

itemListElement.text: Wait for the Apple logo to appear.
Release the top button and Digital Crown.
Allow the device to restart fully before using it again.

title.rendered: Instagram launches Edits app: Is this the ultimate video editing tool for creators?

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Standalone Video Editor: “Edits” is a new, separate app from Instagram, designed specifically for video editing.
  • AI-Powered Features: The app includes AI-powered tools for creating animations, cutouts, and applying filters to your videos.
  • Timeline Editor: It features a timeline editor, giving you more precise control over trimming, splitting, and rearranging your video clips.
  • Creative Tools: You can add audio, text, stickers, and more to enhance your videos.
  • No Watermarks: Videos exported from Edits to Instagram or Facebook do not have a watermark.
  • Inspiration Feed: The app has a built-in “Inspiration” feed to help you discover trending Reels and editing styles.
  • Performance Tracking: You can track the performance of your videos across different platforms.

Instagram has officially rolled out its much-anticipated Edits app, a dedicated video editing tool built for content creators. Initially available for pre-order on iOS, the app is now live on both the App Store and Google Play Store, ready to transform how creators produce and publish videos.

Whether you’re a seasoned Reels maker or just starting out, this new app from Meta might be exactly what you’ve been waiting for.

What is Edits by Instagram?

Edits is far more than just another video editing app; it offers a comprehensive suite of tools for filming, editing, and enhancing videos with AI-powered animations, cutouts, and more. Moreover, as the app is built specifically for keeping creators in mind, the app also includes:

  • AI-powered animations, cutouts, and filters
  • A timeline editor for detailed control
  • Tools to film, enhance, and publish videos
  • No watermark exports to Instagram or Facebook
  • A built-in Inspiration feed with trending Reels and insights

Instagram says Edits was built in collaboration with creators, making it intuitive and powerful enough for daily use. Upcoming updates are expected to bring:

  • Keyframe support
  • Enhanced AI tools
  • Collaborative editing features
  • More voice effects, text styles, and filters

How to use the Instagram Edits app

Getting started with Edits is easy. All you need to do is go to the App Store or Play Store and install the app on your iPhone or Android phone. Once done, here’s a quick guide to help you comprehend the new app:

  1. Launch Edits app, you’ll be greeted with an introductory screen stating “How Edits works.” Simply tap the Join Edits button to proceed.
  2. On the Projects tab, tap the + button to import videos from your library, or tap the Capture in the bottom toolbar to record a video directly in the app.

  3. Once the videos are imported or captured, you can use the timeline editor to trim, split, or rearrange them and add audio, text, stickers, cutouts, and more to make your content stand out.
  4. Once you’re done editing, tap the Export button. The video is saved automatically to your library, and you can also post it directly on Instagram or Facebook to save time.

Bonus features for creators

  • Ideas Section: Save your creative concepts or drafts for future edits.
  • Inspiration Feed: Get inspired by trending Reels and analyze popular editing styles.
  • Performance Insights: Track how your videos perform across platforms.

Ready to cut, create, and conquer?


Whether you’re building quick Reels or telling a deeper story, Instagram Edits simplifies video creation while giving you access to pro-level tools. With AI enhancements, export ease, and creator-first design, it could quickly become your go-to editing companion.

Ready to create content that stands out? Now’s the perfect time to download Edits and give it a try.

Related articles worth reading:

  • Tips to use Instagram on iPhone like a pro
  • How to find trending audio on Instagram and go viral
  • How to fix “Something Went Wrong” on Instagram
  • How to Use Instagram’s Remix Feature

@graph.name: How to use Instagram Edits app
@graph.description: Learn how to create and edit videos with the Instagram Edits app, from importing or recording footage to applying creative edits and exporting your final video.

supply.name: Smartphone with Instagram Edits app installed

step.name: Join Edits
step.text: Launch the Instagram Edits app. On the welcome screen, tap the Join Edits button to start creating videos.

itemListElement.text: Open the Instagram Edits app on your phone.
Tap the Join Edits button on the welcome screen.

step.name: Import or capture videos
step.text: On the Projects tab, tap the plus icon to import videos from your library, or choose Capture from the toolbar to record directly in the app.

itemListElement.text: Go to the Projects tab in the app.
Tap the plus button to import videos from your library.
Alternatively, tap Capture in the toolbar to record a new video.

step.name: Edit your videos
step.text: Use the timeline editor to trim, split, or rearrange clips, and add creative elements like audio, text, stickers, and cutouts to enhance your video.

itemListElement.text: Select a video clip on the timeline.
Trim or split the clip as needed.
Rearrange clips by dragging them along the timeline.
Add effects such as music, text overlays, stickers, and cutouts.

step.name: Export and share your video
step.text: Once your edits are complete, tap the Export button to save the video to your library or share it directly on Instagram or Facebook.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Export button in the top-right corner.
Wait for the export to finish.
Your video is automatically saved to your device library.
You can also share it instantly to Instagram or Facebook.

title.rendered: How to Restore Streak on Snapchat Easily?

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Snapstreaks disappear if you or your friend don’t exchange photo or video snaps within 24 hours.
  • An ⌛ Hourglass emoji appears as a warning before a streak ends.
  • Snapchat+ users get five free restores per month; free users get one restore.
  • After using free restores, you can pay $0.99 to restore a Snapstreak
  • If the Restore button isn’t available, you can submit a request via Snapchat Support.
  • Snapchat only restores streaks lost due to technical issues, not user negligence.

Like real-life relationships, Snapstreaks are a two-way street—you can’t maintain one alone. Snapchat streaks not only help you stay connected with friends but also keep you updated on their daily lives. So, when your beloved Snapstreak suddenly disappears, it can be incredibly frustrating. This typically happens when either you or your Snap buddy fails to send a photo or video snap (not a chat) for just one day.

The good news? Snapchat gives you a limited-time option to restore a lost Snapstreak. In this guide, you’ll learn exactly how to restore a Snapstreak on Snapchat, with or without the in-app Restore option.

Table of Contents
  • How Does a Snapchat Streak Work?
  • How to Restore Streaks on Snapchat?
    • 1. How to Restore Snapchat Streak For Free
    • 2. Contact Snapchat Support to Restore a Streak

How Does a Snapchat Streak Work?

Before jumping into the recovery process, let’s quickly revisit how Snapstreaks function. To make your snaps more engaging and fun, you can try using some of the best Snapchat filters available.

A Snapstreak begins when you and a friend exchange photo or video snaps for three consecutive days. Once this happens, a 🔥 Fire emoji appears next to your friend’s name, along with the number of days the streak has lasted.

To keep the streak alive, both of you must send each other a snap within every 24-hour period. If either person misses a day, the streak ends. Snapchat tries to help by displaying an ⌛ Hourglass emoji next to the streak, signaling that time is running out.

So, if you see the Hourglass icon, it means you or your friend hasn’t sent a snap in the last 24 hours. Act fast to keep the streak going!

How to Restore Streaks on Snapchat?

Snapstreaks break easily, but restoring them has become a lot simpler thanks to Snapchat’s official restore feature. Whether your streak disappeared due to a technical glitch or a simple oversight, here are two effective ways to get it back.

1. How to Restore Snapchat Streak For Free

As of March 2023, Snapchat introduced a built-in Snapstreak restore feature, allowing users to recover streaks without contacting support.

  • Snapchat+ subscribers receive five free restores per month.
  • Non-Snapchat+ users get one free restore.
  • After your free quota, you can still restore a streak by paying $0.99 per restore.

Steps to Restore a Snapstreak Using the App:

  1. Open the Snapchat app and tap the Chats icon at the bottom.
  2. Find the conversation with the broken streak.
  3. Tap the Restore button next to the chat (if available).
  4. Confirm by tapping Restore again in the pop-up prompt.

Note If you don’t see the Restore option, too much time may have passed since the streak ended.

2. Contact Snapchat Support to Restore a Streak

If the restore button isn’t visible—or if it doesn’t work—you can submit a manual request to Snapchat support.

Here’s how to do it:

  1. o to the official Snapchat Restoration Request page.
  2. Fill out the form with the necessary details (your username, friend’s name, streak info).
  3. Tap Submit at the bottom.

Note If your streak ended due to user negligence (i.e., you simply forgot), Snapchat may deny your request. Support typically only restores streaks lost due to technical errors.

Snapstreak Restored… Now What?

And there you have it—you’ve just learned how to restore your Snapstreak! But remember: a streak only works if both users are equally committed. If your friend isn’t actively snapping back, restoring the streak may not be worth it.

Save your free restore (and your $0.99) for connections that truly matter.

Still have questions or facing an issue? Drop a comment below—we’re here to help!

FAQs

How much does it cost to restore a Snapstreak?

You get one free restore, but after that, each Snapstreak restore costs $0.99.

How can I view all my active Snapstreaks on Snapchat?

Open the Snapchat app, go to the Chats list, and tap the Streaks tab at the top. This shows only the chats with active streaks.

How long does the Hourglass emoji last on Snapchat?

Once the Hourglass emoji appears, you typically have up to 24 hours to exchange a snap. It disappears when both of you send a snap—or if neither of you does.

@graph.name: How to Restore Snapchat Streak For Free
@graph.description: Learn how to restore a broken Snapchat streak for free using the built-in Restore option in the app.

step.name: Open Snapchat and go to Chats
step.text: Launch the Snapchat app on your phone and tap the Chats icon at the bottom of the screen.

itemListElement.text: Open Snapchat on your device.
Tap the Chats icon located at the bottom.

step.name: Locate the broken streak
step.text: Find the conversation with the person whose streak has ended.

itemListElement.text: Scroll through your chats list.
Find the chat with the broken streak icon.

step.name: Tap the Restore button
step.text: If available, tap the Restore button next to the chat with the broken streak.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Restore option beside the chat.

step.name: Confirm the restoration
step.text: Tap Restore again in the confirmation pop-up to restore your streak.

itemListElement.text: Read the pop-up confirmation message.
Tap Restore again to complete the process.

blockGraphs.question: How much does it cost to restore a Snapstreak?
blockGraphs.answer: You get one free restore, but after that, each Snapstreak restore costs $0.99.

blockGraphs.question: How can I view all my active Snapstreaks on Snapchat?
blockGraphs.answer: Open the Snapchat app, go to the Chats list, and tap the Streaks tab at the top. This shows only the chats with active streaks.

blockGraphs.question: How long does the Hourglass emoji last on Snapchat?
blockGraphs.answer: Once the Hourglass emoji appears, you typically have up to 24 hours to exchange a snap. It disappears when both of you send a snap—or if neither of you does.

title.rendered: Apple Rolls Out iOS 18.6 with Security Fixes and EU App Store Changes

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • iOS 18.6 is now available for all supported iPhones and can be installed via Settings, though some users may see a staggered rollout.
  • Fixes key bugs and improves system stability including a Photos memory movie issue and other under-the-hood enhancements.
  • Updates App Store rules in the EU to support direct installation of third-party marketplaces under the Digital Markets Act.
  • Brings regulatory and security improvements affecting how apps are installed, with changes most visible to users in EU countries.
  • Watch for rollout delays and compatibility limits as some features, like marketplace changes, only apply to EU devices running iOS 18.6.

Apple has officially pushed iOS 18.6 to all supported iPhones, wrapping up nearly six weeks of beta testing. The update delivers a round of security patches and bug fixes, along with regulatory adjustments targeted at European Union users.

How to Get iOS 18.6

Users with iPhones running iOS 18 can grab the update by going to:

  1. Settings → General → Software Update.
  2. Once it appears, tap Download & Install.

The update carries build number 22G86 and is rolling out in waves, so it may not show up on all devices right away.

What’s New in iOS 18.6?

Apple’s release notes call out several changes:

  • A patch for a Photos bug that previously blocked some memory movies from being shared.
  • General stability improvements and security fixes across the system.

Beyond the usual maintenance, the update introduces important updates for users in the EU. iOS 18.6 tweaks how apps can be installed directly from developer websites:

  • A new process now allows installation of third-party app marketplaces from outside the App Store.
  • Apple has also revised the direct-from-developer app installation flow.

These adjustments are part of Apple’s response to the Digital Markets Act, which is forcing the company to open parts of its platform to alternative distribution methods in the EU.

For those tracking security updates, Apple has published a detailed changelog on its support site.

Why This Release Matters

iOS 18.6 is more than just routine maintenance. It’s part of Apple’s broader shift in how it handles compliance with EU regulations, with meaningful changes to how apps are discovered and installed. For users outside the EU, the update still brings important security protections and small quality-of-life tweaks.

Already installed iOS 18.6 and noticed anything different? Drop your observations in the comments.

mainEntity.name: Are UDID and serial number similar on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: UDID and serial number are two distinct things. The UDID is a unique 40-character alphanumeric code used by developers to identify an individual iPhone or iPad. keyPoints.title: Availability and Installation of iOS 18.6
keyPoints.explanation: The update is available for all supported iPhones, and users can install it via Settings > General > Software Update, though it may roll out gradually.

keyPoints.title: Main Features and Fixes in iOS 18.6
keyPoints.explanation: It includes security patches, bug fixes such as resolving a Photos issue affecting memory movies, and system stability improvements.

keyPoints.title: Enhanced EU App Store Regulations
keyPoints.explanation: iOS 18.6 introduces changes allowing direct installation of third-party app marketplaces and revising the app installation flow, aligning with EU Digital Markets Act requirements.

keyPoints.title: Security and Regulatory Updates
keyPoints.explanation: Besides bug fixes, the update enhances security and incorporates regulatory changes affecting app installation processes, especially for EU users.

keyPoints.title: Significance of the Update
keyPoints.explanation: iOS 18.6 reflects Apple's adaptation to EU regulations while providing security enhancements and minor quality-of-life improvements for all users.

title.rendered: iPhone 17 Pro Leak Shows Bold New Orange Color Option

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • iPhone 17 Pro dummy units show bold new orange along with black, white, gray, and blue—offering an early look at possible 2025 finishes.
  • Orange finish may lean metallic at launch with early prototypes suggesting copper tones or brushed aluminum rather than flat matte orange.
  • Color tweaks mix old and new tones with darker blacks and richer blues joining classic white and gray from earlier Pro models.
  • Dummy units aren’t final indicators since lighting and plastic shells often distort Apple’s actual material colors and finish.
  • More vibrant lineup could break design norms as Apple leans into bolder hues that may contrast its usual minimalist Pro aesthetic.

With Apple’s fall event approaching fast, new iPhone 17 Pro leaks are ramping up, and a fresh batch of dummy units might offer the clearest preview yet of Apple’s upcoming Pro color palette.

Dummy Units Suggest New and Returning Finishes

Leaker Sonny Dickson has shared a new set of images showing what appear to be iPhone 17 Pro dummies in five different finishes: black, white, gray, dark blue, and a vivid orange. The standout this time is clearly the orange model, a tone far more saturated than Apple typically selects for its Pro lineup.

That orange hue may not make it to shelves exactly as shown. Earlier reports suggested Apple was testing a copper-adjacent tone, which could mean this bright finish ends up looking more metallic and muted in the final version. Still, compared to past Pro color options, it’s a noticeably bolder move.

Dark blue, also part of the dummy set, skews richer than the navy Apple introduced with earlier Pro generations. Black and white return as expected, though Dickson’s photos hint that this year’s black might go even darker than the iPhone 16 Pro’s shade. The inclusion of gray lines up with prior rumors as well, filling out a set that balances new experimentation with familiar tones.

How the Dummy Colors Stack Up

Realistic Preview or Rough Mock-Up?

While dummy units are often close matches in terms of size and design, their color accuracy is notoriously unreliable. Differences in lighting, materials, or even production techniques can throw off the final look. That played out last year with the iPhone 15 Pro’s Desert Titanium, which looked noticeably different in early leaks versus launch-day photos.

Even so, with Apple expected to announce the iPhone 17 series around September 9, these prototypes could be the closest early look we’ll get. If the orange shade makes the final cut, it would mark a rare splash of color in a Pro line that typically favors restrained finishes.

A Louder Direction for the Pro Line?

If this leak holds, the iPhone 17 Pro could be Apple’s most visually diverse Pro offering to date, which might appeal to users who want premium specs without the typical monochrome.

Would a copper-toned iPhone Pro catch your eye, or does Apple risk straying too far from its minimalist roots? Let us know what you think below.

  • iPhone 17 Pro Rumored to Get Anti-Reflective Display
  • iPhone 17 Pro Leak Reveals Major MagSafe Redesign and Relocated Logo

keyPoints.explanation: Leaker Sonny Dickson shared images of dummy units in five finishes—black, white, gray, dark blue, and a bright orange—providing a preview of Apple's upcoming color palette, with the orange hue being notably bold and saturated.

keyPoints.title: Potential Final Color Outcomes for iPhone 17 Pro Finishes
keyPoints.explanation: While the dummy units show vibrant colors, especially the orange which may appear more metallic in final form, the actual product might have subtle variations, with earlier tests hinting at a copper or metallic finish.

keyPoints.title: Comparison of Dummy Colors to Previous iPhone Pro Models
keyPoints.explanation: The dummy colors suggest darker blacks, richer blue shades, and familiar finishes like white and gray, indicating a mix of new experimentation and classic tones in the upcoming iPhone 17 Pro lineup.

keyPoints.title: Limitations of Dummy Units for Accurate Color Representation
keyPoints.explanation: Since dummy units often differ in color due to lighting and material differences, the actual final colors may vary, but these leaks offer a close early look before official release.

keyPoints.title: Implications of a Colorful iPhone 17 Pro Lineup
keyPoints.explanation: If the leaks are accurate, the iPhone 17 Pro could be Apple's most visually diverse line yet, possibly appealing to users seeking a vibrant, less monochrome premium device, although it might challenge Apple's minimalist design ethos.

title.rendered: How to Change Fonts on iPhone: Easy Tips Without Jailbreaking

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Main Limitation: You cannot change the default system font on iOS, but you can install new fonts for supported apps.
  • System-Wide Adjustments: While you can’t change the font style, you can adjust text size and boldness system-wide for readability.
  • In-App Customization: Apps like Pages, Keynote, and Mail allow you to change fonts and text styles within them.
  • Installing Custom Fonts: Install custom fonts for use in compatible apps using dedicated font apps from the App Store.
  • Managing Fonts: Manage or remove installed custom fonts at any time via the Settings app to revert to default.

Changing the font on your iPhone can make your device feel more personal and easier to read. Unfortunately, Apple doesn’t let you change the system-wide font, but you can still tweak it in specific apps, adjust text size, or use third-party apps for more options. This article walks you through all the safe and easy ways to change the font on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Why You Might Want to Change Fonts on iPhone
  • Understanding Font Limitations in iOS
  • How to Change Font Size in iPhone Settings
    • How to Make Text Bold and Adjust Display Contrast
  • How to Use Fonts in Notes, Pages, and Mail
    • Customize Font Style in Notes App
    • Change Font Style in Apple Pages
    • Change Font Style in Mail App (iOS 26+)
  • How to Install Custom Fonts on iPhone
    • Method 1: Install Fonts from iPhone Settings
    • Method 2: Use Font Installer Apps
    • Method 3: Use Configuration Profiles with iFont
  • How to Use Custom Fonts in Third-Party Apps
    • How to Change Keyboard Fonts on iPhone
  • Best Font Apps for iPhone in 2025
  • Troubleshooting Font Installation Issues
  • How to Manage and Remove Fonts on iPhone
  • How to Revert to the Default Font
  • Final Thoughts

Why You Might Want to Change Fonts on iPhone

Fonts play a big role in how you interact with your iPhone. Here are some reasons to customize them:

  • Personalization: A unique font can reflect your style, making your iPhone feel like yours. 
  • Readability: Larger fonts can make text clearer and easier to read. 
  • Creativity: Custom fonts in apps like Pages, Mail, or Notes let you create eye-catching documents or messages. 
  • Accessibility: Bold font style can help people with dyslexia, low vision, or reading difficulties. 

Keeping this in mind, Apple offers text accessibility settings and app-specific font customization. 

Understanding Font Limitations in iOS

Before proceeding, it is worth noting that iPhone does not allow you to change the default font (such as menu or notification fonts) unless you have jailbroken the device. Apple uses its own font, San Francisco (SF Pro), for a consistent look across the iPhone.

However, there are several ways to adjust font size, weight, and style in settings or specific apps, and you can install custom fonts for use in supported apps like Pages, Keynote, Notes, or Mail.  

In the next section, I’ll share safe, non-jailbreak methods to customize your iPhone’s fonts. 

How to Change Font Size in iPhone Settings

The easiest way to tweak fonts on your iPhone is by adjusting the text size in the Settings app. This changes the font size system-wide, in most Apple apps (like Messages, Notes, and Mail), and some third-party apps that support Dynamic Type.

Here’s how to do it:

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone. 
  2. Tap Display & Brightness.
  3. Select Text Size. 
  4. Use the slider to make the text larger or smaller. You’ll see a preview of how the text will look.
  5. Tap Back to save your changes.

This method doesn’t change the font style (it stays as SF Pro), but it makes text easier to read. Changes apply instantly to supported apps. 

How to Make Text Bold and Adjust Display Contrast

For more control, you can make text bolder or use accessibility features:

Enable Bold Text:

  1. Go to Settings > Display & Brightness.
  2. Toggle on Bold Text.

Your iPhone will apply the changes instantly. This makes all system text (like app names and menus) bolder for better readability.

Use Accessibility Options:

  1. Open Settings and select Accessibility > Display & Text Size.
  2. Try these options:
    • Larger Text: Use the slider for even bigger font sizes than the standard Text Size setting.
    • Increase Contrast: Makes text and buttons stand out against backgrounds.

For specific apps, go to Settings > Accessibility > Per-App Settings and select an app to set custom font sizes for individual apps.

iOS 26 also introduced a new accessibility feature called Accessibility Reader to adjust font, spacing, and colors for any app or even physical text via Magnifier. These settings are great for users who need clearer text but don’t change the font family. 

How to Use Fonts in Notes, Pages, and Mail

Some Apple apps let you customize font style and typefaces, but only within the app itself. Here’s how: 

Customize Font Style in Notes App

In the Notes app, you can only change the text formatting to make it look organized.

  1. Open the Notes app and tap the pen icon to start a new note. 
  2. Tap the Aa button above the keyboard. 
  3. Choose from paragraph styles like Title, Heading, or Body. You can’t pick a new font family, but you can adjust the size and weight. 
  4. Tap the X icon and type your text. Changes apply only to that text.

Change Font Style in Apple Pages

You can create documents like reports, newsletters, flyers, cards, etc., with different fonts for more creative presentations.

  1. Launch the Pages app. Select Start Writing for a blank page or Choose a Template.  
  2. Tap the paintbrush icon at the top toolbar, then double-tap on the text to select it.
  3. Select the Font option to choose from available fonts or any custom fonts you’ve installed (more on that later). 
  4. Tap the info icon next to the font to select its typeface like Regular, Light, Semibold, Condensed, etc. 
  5. Now, tap < Text to get back and customize paragraph style, format, size, or text color as needed.

Tip: You can use the same steps on other iWork apps such as Keynote and Numbers. 

Change Font Style in Mail App (iOS 26+)

With iOS 26, you can customize your email text fonts for more personalization.  

  1. Open the Mail app and tap the pen icon to start writing an email.
  2. Tap the body text field and you will see a toolbar pop up above your keyboard.
  3. Select Aa from the toolbar.
  4. Tap Default Font dropdown in the menu and select Choose Font.
  5. Scroll through the built-in font list and choose a font.
  6. Now, you can write the email in that font.

By providing the native font library, Apple is opening its door to more customization. We hope to see more native apps include this feature.

How to Install Custom Fonts on iPhone

To use fonts beyond Apple’s defaults, you can install custom fonts for apps like Pages, Keynote, or third-party apps. Here are three ways to do it:

Method 1: Install Fonts from iPhone Settings

Apple has a default font library and multiple add-ons that you can download on your iPhone. These system fonts are available for use in the supported apps mentioned above.

  1. Go to Settings > General > Fonts.
  2. You will see System Fonts, where all the built-in fonts are listed.
  3. Select More fonts and tap the download icon next to a font to install it.  
  4. The font will be available in compatible apps.

Method 2: Use Font Installer Apps

Font installer apps make it easy to add new fonts in bundles. Popular apps include AnyFont, Font Diner, and others.

Let’s look at how to download and install custom fonts using the Font Diner app. The steps are similar for most font apps.

  1. Download and open the Font Diner app.
  2. Tap Activate next to the Silverware Font Set and tap Agree on the dialog box.
  3. Choose Install and tap Close.

Now, this font will be available in the supported apps. Font Diner allows you to download one free Silverware set of 23 fonts.

To get additional fonts, you must make an in-app annual purchase for other font sets.

Method 3: Use Configuration Profiles with iFont

Some websites or developers offer font configuration profiles to manually add fonts to your iPhone. Here’s how to do it using the iFont app:

  1. Open the iFont app and select Import Font.
  2. If you have downloaded a font file, select Import from Files. For this example, we’ll use Google Fonts.
  3. Scroll through the font library and tap Get to download it.
  4. Tap the X icon and swipe down to return to the home page.
  5. Tap Install next to the font and tap Continue to proceed.
  6. Tap Allow to install the configuration profile.

Now that you have downloaded the profile, you need to install it on your iPhone:

  1. Go to Settings > General > VPN & Device Management and select the profile.
  2. Tap Install at the top right corner and enter your passcode.
  3. Tap Install again in the dialog box.
  4. The font will now be available in supported apps.

Safety Tip: Only download profiles from reputable sources to avoid malware or any risks to your system.

How to Use Custom Fonts in Third-Party Apps

Many third-party apps, such as design tools and note-taking apps, support custom fonts. Here’s how to use them:

  1. Install a design app (e.g., Canva, Notion, or Procreate).
  2. Create a new project and look for the font menu in the text settings.
  3. Select your installed font from the list. You may see a “My Font” option.

How to Change Keyboard Fonts on iPhone

Some keyboard apps, like Fonts – AI Sticker or Keyboard Fonts, let you type with custom fonts in text-supported apps:

  1. Download a keyboard app from the App Store. 
  2. Go to Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards. 
  3. Tap Add New Keyboard and select the font keyboard.
  4. Select the keyboard again and toggle on Allow Full Access.
  5. Tap Allow to grant permission. 
  6. When typing in apps like Messages, tap the Globe icon to switch to the font keyboard and choose a style.

The first time, you may need to set up the keyboard from within the app.

Note: These keyboards only work in apps that allow custom keyboards, like Messages or WhatsApp, and may not support all fonts in every app.

Best Font Apps for iPhone in 2025

Here are some top-rated font apps for iPhone available on the App Store:

  • AnyFont: Offers a wide range of fonts and easy profile installation. Great for PowerPoint, Word, and Excel for iOS. 
  • Font Diner: Fun, creative fonts for design projects. Includes free and paid options. 
  • iFont App: Install fonts using TTF, OTF, or TTC format files. Also lets you access Google Fonts’ free font library.
  • Fonts – Install Fonts: A simple app with a mix of free and premium fonts, ideal for social media or notes. 
  • Font Generator: Popular for decorative fonts, perfect for messages or posts. 

Always check user reviews and ensure the app is updated for iOS 26 compatibility. 

Troubleshooting Font Installation Issues

If you run into problems, try these fixes: 

  • Font not showing in apps: Ensure the app supports custom fonts. Reinstall the font profile or restart your iPhone. 
  • Profile won’t install: Go to VPN & Device Management and check for errors. Download the profile again from a trusted source.
  • App crashes after font installation: Delete the font (Settings > General > Fonts) and try a different font or app.
  • Fonts look blurry: Some fonts may not be optimized for iOS. Choose high-quality fonts from reputable apps. 

If issues persist, contact the font app’s support team or Apple Support.

How to Manage and Remove Fonts on iPhone

To keep your iPhone running smoothly, manage your installed fonts:

  1. Go to Settings > General > Fonts. 
  2. Tap My Fonts to view all installed fonts. 
  3. Tap a font to see details like typefaces, copyright, and version.
  4. Tap the bin icon at the top and select Remove to delete it.

Regularly check for updates to font apps to ensure compatibility with the latest iOS version.

How to Revert to the Default Font

If you want to go back to Apple’s default font (SF Pro): 

  1. Remove custom font profiles: Go to VPN & Device Management, tap the font profile, and select Remove Profile. Enter your passcode and tap Remove to confirm.
  2. Reset text size: Go to Settings > Display & Brightness > Text Size and move the slider to the middle.
  3. Turn off Bold Text: In Display & Brightness, toggle off Bold Text.
  4. Restart your iPhone to apply all changes.

This will restore the default look of your iPhone’s text.

Final Thoughts

I hope this guide helped you customize your iPhone. While iOS doesn’t allow system-wide font changes, you can still resize and bold text, install custom fonts for creative or professional use, and type with stylish fonts using keyboard apps. With the introduction of Accessibility Reader, Apple is moving toward a more flexible and user-friendly typography experience.

Do you have a question? Feel free to ask in the comments below!

FAQs

Can I change the system-wide font on iPhone?

No. As of iOS 26, you can’t change the system-wide font without jailbreaking, which is risky and not recommended. You can adjust font size, weight, or use custom fonts in apps like Pages, Mail, or Notes.

What’s the best free font app for iPhone?

Fonts and Font Diner offer free fonts with optional in-app purchases. Check the App Store for the latest free options and read reviews to ensure they’re safe and compatible with the current iOS version.

Is it safe to install fonts using configuration profiles?

Yes, if you download profiles from trusted sources like reputable font apps or well-known developers. Avoid unknown websites to prevent malware or security issues.

Will changing fonts affect app performance?

Installing a few fonts won’t noticeably slow down your iPhone. However, too many font profiles or poorly designed fonts can use extra storage or cause minor lag in some apps. Manage fonts wisely to avoid issues.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the system-wide font on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. As of iOS 26, you can't change the system-wide font without jailbreaking, which is risky and not recommended. You can adjust font size, weight, or use custom fonts in apps like Pages, Mail, or Notes.

mainEntity.name: What's the best free font app for iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fonts and Font Diner offer free fonts with optional in-app purchases. Check the App Store for the latest free options and read reviews to ensure they're safe and compatible with the current iOS version.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to install fonts using configuration profiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you download profiles from trusted sources like reputable font apps or well-known developers. Avoid unknown websites to prevent malware or security issues.

mainEntity.name: Will changing fonts affect app performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a few fonts won't noticeably slow down your iPhone. However, too many font profiles or poorly designed fonts can use extra storage or cause minor lag in some apps. Manage fonts wisely to avoid issues.

@graph.name: How to Customize Font Style in Notes App
@graph.description: Learn how to change text appearance in the Notes app by using built-in paragraph styles like Title, Heading, or Body. Quick and easy steps to make your notes stand out.
tool: iPhone or iPad with the Notes app

step.name: Start a new note
step.text: Open the Notes app and tap the pen icon in the bottom right to create a new note.

itemListElement.text: Launch the Notes app from your home screen.
Tap the pen icon to begin a new note.

step.name: Select a paragraph style
step.text: Tap the Aa button just above the keyboard to see available text styles like Title, Heading, or Body.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Aa icon above your keyboard.
Choose a style such as Title, Heading, or Body.

step.name: Type and apply styles
step.text: Tap the X icon to close the formatting options, then type your note. The style you selected applies only to the text you enter afterward.

itemListElement.text: Tap the X button to close the style panel.
Begin typing your text using the selected style.

@graph.name: How to Change Font Style in Mail App (iOS 26+)
@graph.description: Learn how to change the default font style while composing emails in the Mail app on iOS 26 and later using the built-in font picker.
tool: iPhone or iPad running iOS 26 or later

step.name: Start a new email
step.text: Open the Mail app and tap the pen icon at the bottom right corner to begin composing a new email.

itemListElement.text: Launch the Mail app from your home screen.
Tap the pen icon to create a new email.

step.name: Access the formatting toolbar
step.text: Tap the body of the email to bring up the toolbar above the keyboard, then tap the Aa icon to open formatting options.

itemListElement.text: Tap inside the email body text field.
Tap the Aa icon on the toolbar above the keyboard.

step.name: Choose a font
step.text: From the formatting menu, tap the Default Font dropdown and select Choose Font. Browse the list and pick your preferred font.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Default Font dropdown option.
Select 'Choose Font' from the list.
Scroll and tap on the font you want to use.

step.name: Compose your email
step.text: Once you've selected a font, start writing your email. The chosen font will apply to all the text you type.

itemListElement.text: Start typing your email with the selected font style.

keyPoints.title: Limitations of Changing System Fonts in iOS
keyPoints.explanation: iOS does not allow changing the default system-wide font, as Apple uses its own San Francisco font for consistency, but you can customize text size and style within supported apps.

keyPoints.title: Adjusting Font Size and Accessibility Features
keyPoints.explanation: You can easily change font size system-wide and toggle bold text or contrast in Settings, helping improve readability and accessibility without jailbreaking your device.

keyPoints.title: Using Fonts in Apple Apps like Notes, Pages, and Mail
keyPoints.explanation: Apple apps like Notes, Pages, and Mail allow font customization within the app, such as switching fonts in Pages or adjusting text styles in Mail, to enhance your document and message presentation.

keyPoints.title: Installing Custom Fonts Safely on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: Custom fonts can be added via system font downloads in Settings, font installer apps like AnyFont, or configuration profiles from trusted sources, offering more style options for supported apps.

keyPoints.title: Managing and Reverting Fonts to Default
keyPoints.explanation: You can manage installed fonts through Settings or remove custom profiles to revert to the default SF Pro font, ensuring your device maintains optimal performance and appearance.
